tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo gu ru ā nan+da puṇ+yā ya/ bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' dbyer mi phyed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam mi 'gyur spros pa kun bral yang / /kun rdzob sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor legs sprul te/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /sku brnyan bzhengs tshul rgyal bas gsungs pa yi/ /phyag tshad dang ldan ji bzhin legs rdzogs nas/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho gas bstan 'gro la/ /dge legs 'phel zhing mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub stsol phyir rab gnas cho ga bri// //'dir rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'gro ba'i don du bsam bzhin sku skye ba bzhes pa sngags 'chang mtshungs med rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas don gsal bzhin la/ sa lo chen po'i gsung rgyun phyag len gyis brgyan te/ kye rdo rje'i cho ga dang sbyar nas bshad par bya'o/ /de la rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus/ /yo byad yongs su tshangs nas ni/ /cho ga dag la 'jug par bya/ /zhes dngos bstan drug las ma gsungs kyang / rje btsun rin po ches/ de ltar rab tu gnas par byas pa'i dgos pa ste bdun gsungs pa ltar/ dang po gang la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten yongs su dag pa bzang po ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten lugs ma dang / sman sku dang / bris sku dang / tsha tsha dang / gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bzo'i bya ba rnams tshad dang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mthar phyin par rdzogs par bya/ rgyas par ni don gsal du blta'o/ /gnyis pa gang gis rab tu gnas par byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ de nyid bcu shes shing / byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/

bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas pa/ rnyed pa dang bskur sti la mi lta ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /gsum pa gang rab tu gnas par bya ba'i gnas ni/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa shin tu yangs pa'i sa phyogs su bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa nam bya ba'i dus ni/ rab dpyid zla 'bring po nag pa zla ba/ sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus dang / dgun zla 'bring po rgyal zla ba 'khor lo sgyur rgyal gyi dus gsum gyi yar ngo'i gza' tshes 'dzom pa/ 'bring zla ba gang rung gi yar ngo'i gza' tshes dang ldan pa/ tha ma mar ngo'i nyi shu brgyad yan gang rung gi tshes la/ gza' dang skar ma dus sbyor sogs 'dzom pa'i dus la bya ste/ dkyil 'khor dang ni rab gnas pa/ /yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya/ /gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na/ /mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med/ /ces pa dang / gnam stong dang ni de bzhin du/ /nyi shu dgu la bya ba min/ /zhes gsungs/ tshes grangs shis pa ni/ tshes gnyis/ gsum/ brgyad/ bcu gsum/ bco lnga ste yar ngo'i phyogs dang / mar ngo'i bcu bdun sogs 'gre'o snyam/ skar ma shis pa ni chu stod dam bra/ chu smad dam bre/ snar ma'am birdzi/ gro bzhin nam bya sbo/ dbo'am khra/ snron nam lde'u/ snrubs sam sog pa/ mgo lag rgyal smad/ khrum smad/ me bzhi'am bya ma/ lha 'tshams sam lag sor te 'di rnams bzang / gza' shis pa ni/ zla ba/ lhag pa/ phur bu/ pa sangs rnams bzang / tshes dang gza' 'dzom pa ni/ tshes gsum/ drug bdun/ bcu gcig rnams dang / gza' zla ba tshes gnyis/ bzhi/ brgyad/ bcu/ bcu gcig rnams dang / gza' lhag pa/ tshes gnyis/ bdun/ dgu/ bcu gcig rnams dang gza' phur bu/ tshes drug bdun/ bcu rnams ma gtogs gzhan gong gi tshes grangs tshang ma la gza' pa sangs bzang zhing dge/ dus dang sbyor ba zhi ba la lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de'ang nyi ma byang bgrod kyi dkar po'i tshes la lhag par bzang ngo /

/lnga pa yo byad ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba rnams legs par brtags la ma tshang ba med pa'i yo byad gya noms shing khyad par du 'phags pas brel ba med par bsags pa ste rab tu gnas pa'i bkra shis pa'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa cho ga la gsum/ rgyas pa/ 'bring po/ bsdus pa'o/ /dang po rgyas pa nub gsum pa dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i lugs dang / dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba nub gnyis ma'i lugs so/ /dang po la sta gon dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes so/ /dang po ni/ legs bsham bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la/ /bgegs bskrad mchod de dgug zhugs bya/ /rgyas gdab mchod bstod gtor ma btang / /snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya/ /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/ /rten dgab bdag bsrung sta gon no/ /zhes don bcu gsum gyi/ spyi don dang po legs par bshams pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i yo byad/ rab gnas la dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par sa chog dgos na dbang gi chu bo chen mo la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa'i gzhung rnams dang / sa chog gi phyag len zur du bshad pa ltar du rtogs par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa rnying pa'am/ bla ma gong ma'i bsgrub gnas sogs yid ches pa'i phyogs su mi dgos pas gnas khang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar/ phyag thar dang / bla bre dar gyi lda ldi/ 'phan sogs ci 'byor pa'i brgyan pa'i ji ltar rigs par yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku'am lugs ma sogs gang 'byor bzhugs pa'i mdun/ stegs kyi steng du dam rdzas dang / bskang gso sogs gang dgos mchod pa dang bcas pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan bzhin dang / rab gnas kyi rten dang bstun pa'i stabs gang bder rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi skya thig legs par btab pa la/

kye rdor lha dgu'i tshom bu dang / byang shar du sa lha'i tshom bu bkod pa so so'i phyag len bzhin dang / ras bris yin na stegs ji ltar rigs pa la ras sogs dkar po gtsang ma bkab la/ 'bru gang 'byor gcal du bkram pa'i steng du/ maṇ+ḍal la lha dgu'i tshom bu'i bkod pa dbus su mañdzi'i khar bzhag pa'i 'og tu maṇ+ḍal la sa lha'i tshom bu bkod pa gzhag gzhan yang spyi mchod/ sgos mchod lha grangs dang mnyam pa/ sngon po gtor ma slob ma sta gon dgos na de'i chas sogs dbang chu ltar bsham/ dpon slob rnams kyi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs par rdo dril/ nang mchod/ dbu brgyan/ gos zung rnams dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad gnyis la rnam rgyal dang / las bum/ mgul chings/ kha rgyan/ bum mtshan/ nang rdzas sogs dbang chu bzhin dang / 'thor nas snod dang bcas pa/ maṇ+ḍal phru dgu/ maṇ+ḍal nas dang bcas pa/ rnga cha lang dung sogs sgrub mchod la ji ltar dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsham/ rab gnas kyi rten gsar pa che zhing / gtsug lag khang lta bu gnas de nyid du brtan par bzhugs pa yin na/ thog ma nas zhal shar gzigs sogs gnas khang dang bstun pa'i lhus things par byed/ gzhan spyan drangs du btub pa rnams stegs mtho bar dar zab la sogs pa gang 'byor gyi stan la bzhugs su gsol/ gsung rab/ mchod rten/ phyag mtshan sogs kyang de bzhin bya/ bris sku yin na dgram/ sku sogs la dar ram/ ras ser pos g.yogs/ bris sku rnams zhal khebs bkab la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags a mṛ ta lan gsum tsam bzlas pas bsrung ba las gzhan ci yang mi dgos so/ /de nas dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ tshogs pa che zhing slob dpon du 'os pa dang / rgyas par byed spro na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bya/ ma byas kyang nyes pa med/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lus dkyil dang bcas pa rdzogs par bsgom zhing /

bzlas pa bsdus nas mchod bstod dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon rnams dbang chu bzhin byed/ de nas gtor bsngo/ bskang ba/ thun gtor 'bul ba sogs dgos na so so'i phyag bzhin dang / slob ma yod na slob ma sta gon byas la/ rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar sgrub mchod ji lta ba bzhin byed/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na thig tshon byin rlabs/ bri zhing rgyan dgram pa rnams bya/ ras bris yin na dkyil thang bkram pa ste nub dang po'i chos so/ /nub gnyis pa dkyil 'khor dngos kyi dang po rab gnas kyi sta gon ste/ de la dkyil 'khor bya ba mchod gtor sogs sgrub mchod ji lta ba bzhin dang / slob ma yod na de'i dbang rdzas kyang bsham/ gnyis pa rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad ni/ rten gsar pa'i mdun du stegs bang rim can la chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / gzhan yang me tog spos/ mar me/ yon chab/ zhal zas rnams ji ltar 'byor ba phreng tshar du bkod pa mdzes par bsham/ 'di dag gtsang zhing rgya che ba rang byung na bzang ste/ rgyas pa'i las dang / bsod nams gsog pa'i rten yin pa'i phyir ro/ /logs zhig tu mchod pa kha gso ba'i yo byad kyi mchod 'bul/ mar me/ zhal zas rnams mkho ba tshod gzhag rten gsar pa'i mdun ji ltar rigs par ras ser po la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po bting pa'i steng du/ ras ser po la chu tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar rin po che cha dgu pa zhes bya ba zur brgyad lte ba dang dgu'i rnam pa'o/ /zhes ṭī ka gur rgyan las gsungs pa ltar bri/ 'dab ma rnams la bkra shis rtags brgyad bris pa'i khrus stegs dgram pa'i dbus su mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar gser/ dngul/ ra gan la sogs pa rin po che'i khrus gzhong bu ga dang bral ba bzhag pa'i nang du/ rten rgya gar ma la sogs pa rnying pa chung ngu rab gnas can li ma sogs pa chu'i skyon mi 'byung ba'am/

sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam/ rdo rje la sogs pa gang rung bzhag de dang nye bar maṇ+ḍal la gur gum dang gi hang bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chus oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bi d+yā swāhā zhes dang / rten 'brel snying po rnams bris pa bzhag 'di 'og gi khrus long byed rgyu yin/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du dri'i bum pa ste pad+ma re'i steng du g.yas skor gyis khrus bum brgyad po kha rgyan/ mgul chings/ nang rdzas ni dri'i bum par tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gur gum sogs dri bzang gang 'byor/ mngar gsum la ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi gang 'byor/ zho'i bum par zho'i spris ma med pa cung zad/ 'bras bu'i bum par a bar skyur gsum sogs gang 'byor/ 'bru'i bum par nas gro 'bras sran sogs 'bru'i rigs/ 'bras yos kyi bum par 'bras brngos pa'am/ phyag len la lho nas 'ong ba'i 'bras phal sgye zer ba'i 'bras leb mo 'di la mdzad par snang bas gang bde'o/ /sman gyi bum par bzang drug kaṇ+ṭa ka ri/ dbang lag sogs gang 'byor/ rin po che'i bum par gser/ dngul/ byu ru sogs rin po che'i rigs gang rnyed de/ bum rdzas de rnams zhib par btags la dri bzang gi chu dang bsres nas bum pa so so'i nang du ma nor bar sum cha tsam blugs la mchu rnams dbus su bstan ste bzhag yang khrus bum brgyad ye ma 'byor na bum pa gcig tu bum rdzas brgyad char blugs pa/ rang gi mdun las bum gyi 'phris su bum gdan 'dab brgyad la bzhag pas kyang rung / khrus stegs kyi gang 'os su ting la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar snum la dri bzang cung zad btab pa/ yang snod gcig tu rgya nag nas 'byung ba'i sran dkar ram/ de ma 'byor na dbus su skye ba'i rgya sran dkar po brjen btags byas pa'i sran dkar gyi phye ma de dang dri bzang gi chu 'de gu/ de gnyis maṇ+ḍal la byug pa'i ras la sogs pa gtsang ma'i pir re so sor bcug pa/ sku'i srub brad phyis byed pa'i tshul gyis dur ba'i chun po/

ga ḍu ba la sogs par bshal chu'i chu gtsang ma/ ras sam/ dar dkar po la dri'i thig le lnga'am/ rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pa'i sku phyis/ khrus long ni gong du bsham zin/ bgegs zhi bas sbyangs pa'i gtor ma gsum ni phyag len la bgegs gtor 'dra ba'i mtheb kyu gsum la dkar rgyan rgyab pa/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'i ting lo dang chang bu bsgrags pa gsum/ drag pos sbyang ba'i gu gul sogs/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i til rnams phyag len bzhin bsham mo// //spyi don gnyis pa bdag bskyed pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed cing mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / mchod pa dang / phyi rol pa'i gtor ma btang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol ste lhag chad kha bskang ba dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma yod na dbang bskur ba rnams dbang chu ltar so so'i phyag len bzhin byas la// //spyi don gsum pa bum pa bzlas pa ni/ rnam rgyal dang / las bum ni mdang nub bum pa sta gon gyi skabs su bsgrub zin pas 'dir mi dgos/ khrus bum brgyad po khrus stegs thag rings na rang gi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs par nas la sogs pa'i pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bkod/ dri'i bum pa'i steng du rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag gzungs thag gi khrus bum thams cad kyi mchu la bskor nas bzhag pa la/ las bum gyi chu ku shas khrus bum rnams la gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa rnams yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang so so'i rdzas kyis yongs su gang bar gyur zhes brjod cing slob dpon gyis gzungs thag nas blangs te dri'i bum pa la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha snā na pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ḥ

de bzhin du sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las mngar gsum gyi bum pa la gan+dha'i gnas su tri ma dhu dang / zho'i bum pa la ma la dang / 'bras kyi bum pa la pha la dang / 'bru'i bum pa la bru hi dang / 'bras yos kyi bum pa la lardza dang / sman gyi bum pa la o ṣa dhi dang / rin po che'i bum pa la ma ṇi rnams 'don pa bsgyur zhing sbyar ba lan nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas/ thun mong du gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring tshar gsum/ las thams cad pa'i sngags a mṛ ta ci nus bzlas tshar ba dang / nang rdzas rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing gzungs thag bsdu'o// //spyi don bzhi pa rten sbyang ba la gnyis/ bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la zhi bas sbyang ba/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ drag pos sbyang ba gsum las/ dang po ni rten la g.yogs pa'i dar la sogs pa dang / zhal khebs rnams bsal la dpon slob rnams bzhengs te gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma gtor theb la sogs pa'i snod gsum gyi nang du bzhag pa sbyang stegs kyi steng du bshams/ de rnams kyi bsrag tu ting lo dang chang bu bsgrags pa gsum po yang rim pa bzhin ting lo rnams sbar la bzhag gtor ma gsum chus bran la mchod g.yog pas gtor ma gsum re re bzhin rten gsar pa rnams la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba'i tshul bya zhing / dpon slob thams cad kyi phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya g.yas phyogs bskor zhing / mthar se gol gtogs la byin rlabs mi dgos pas oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khaṃ bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma rnams snod gcig tu bsags/ dpon slob rnams kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig

ces brjod/ gnyis pa zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba ni/ ting lo dang chang bu rten la mchod g.yog pas gong bzhin bskor zhing gtor ma'i 'khris su bzhag dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje gsor zhing sum+bha ni zlos pa lan gsum byas la/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma dang ting lo sogs phyi rol du dor/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces brjod/ gsum pa drag pos sbyang ba ni/ dpon slob rnams khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rdo rje dril bu dang / slob dpon gyis spos thogs te rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ces brjod cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa med ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jig pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs su 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos bzhag oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃḥ oṃ ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ ces brjod/ dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/

/khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /bsdigs 'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul sdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo stang stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung bsregs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyur 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs/ /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa tshar gcig dang / 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sh+lau ka gcig po lan gsum brjod/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis kye rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la/

zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig gal te mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes drag tu brjod la/ rten rnams gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar dang nas bsres pas brab/ sna tshogs pa'i rol mo drag tu bya zhing / rtsa sngags aṣ+ṭa dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags a mṛ ta sogs drag sngags gang shes mang du bzlas/ sems kyis bgegs thams cad phyi rol du bros par bsam mo/ /de 'dra ba lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ mchod g.yog pa'i mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag til mchod g.yog pa'i lag mthil gnyis su blugs la/ rten gsar pa la kha phyogs pas lag pa g.yas kyis g.yas dang / g.yon gyis g.yon du bskor/ gnyis ka gshibs la g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing / mthar lag pa bsnol te g.yas kyis me dang / g.yon gyis chu la sngags dang bstun nas dor/ de bzhin lan gsum byas te/ g.yas kyi ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ g.yon gyi rgya mtshos bkrus par bsam la dpon slob rnams kyi ngag tu/ bdag dang yon bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams snying khar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa sna sgor sdig pa ra can gyi rnam par thon nas mdun gyi til la thim pa de nyid/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsreg cing g.yon du rgya mtsho'i chus bkrus par gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod cing mchod g.yog pas chu de'i khar me de nas cung zad blugs te rgya mtsho chen por dor bar bsams la phyi rol tu gtor/ dpon slob rnams kyis bdag dang yon bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig

ces brjod cing bsam// //spyi don lnga pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ rten gsar pa la khrus bya ba'i sngon du khrus stegs kyi steng gi rten sogs dang / me long gi yig 'bru rnams las bum gyi chus mchod g.yog pas bkru zhing / sku phyis phrag pa g.yon par bkal la/ dpon slob rnams kyi dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / 'dir ni khrus mchog sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /ces brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo bya/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs gsum ka'i mjug tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ mchod g.yog pas bum chus sngags rnams dag par bkrus shing / rten nam ring bsrel lam rdo rje gang yin la khrus long gi chu de 'phog par bya'o/ /de nas mchod g.yog pas sku phyis phrag pa g.yon nas phab ste me long nang du sku sogs gzugs can shar ba de phyis par bsam la/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi 'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃḥhrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ne swāhā/ zhes pas sku phyis par bsam mo/ /de nas khrus stegs kyi sku'am rdo rje sogs stegs ji ltar rigs par bzhugs su gsol/ khrus chu de khrus bum brgyad por bgos la blug de nas rten gsar pa spyan drang du btub cing chu'i skyon mi yong ba rnams khrus stegs su bzhag nas dngos su bkru bar gsungs kyang / bla ma rnams phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir rten rnams khrus long gi ngos la sku'i gzugs can rnams shar bar mos pa byas la/ mchod g.yog pas khrus stegs kyi stengs su rtsog pur 'dug la/ lag pa g.yon gyi khrus long dang / g.yas kyi rdzas snum sogs dang /

khrus chu rnams tshig dang bstun nas sku mnye brad pa'i tshul dang / bkru zhing bum chu rnams khrus gzhong gi nang du 'ong bar bya/ sku phyis kyang gong dang 'dra/ de nas mchod g.yog pas snum la dri bzang btab pa nas pir gyis blang / dpon slob rnams kyi gdangs dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal bsal slad du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'dis bkrus pas/ /bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swāhā/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i/ dang po la mchod g.yog pas me long nang gi sku gzugs la sku mnye byed par bsam zhing dri bzang btab pa'i snum me long la byugs/ sngags gnyis pa la sran dkar gyi 'dag chal gyi byug cing mnye bar bsam/ sngags gsum pa la dur ba'i chun pos me long la drud cing sku'i srub rnams brad par bsam/ ga ḍu ba'i chu gtsang gis me long gi 'dan la bshal chus bkrus la/ de nas dri'i bum pa thogs la/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzad/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ sngags kyi rings la me long gi gdan la sku khrus gsol/ dri'i bum pa bzhag la/ de dag sku la sogs sngags bcas gong bzhin gyi sku phyi'o/ /cho ga sogs kyi chings khrus bum brgyad ka la 'dis rigs 'gre'o/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i sku la sogs mi dgos/ de nas kā ya bi sho dha na'i sngags gsum dang bstun rdzas gsum gyis byug chu gtsang gis bkru/ de nas mngar gsum gyi bum pa thogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyi ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya 'o/

/sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las gan+dha snā na'i gnas su tri ma dhu snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag kyis sku phyi'o/ /yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byugs nas chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ zho'i bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtong ba dri yi legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /tri ma dhu snā ni gnas su ma la snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyi sku phyi/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyi byugs nas/ chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ 'bru'i bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /tshul khrims dri yi legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /ma la snā na'i gnas su pha la snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyi sku phyi'o/ /yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byug cing / chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ 'bru'i bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bzod pa dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /pha la snā na'i gnas su bru hi snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyi/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byug cing chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ 'bras yos kyi bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /brtson 'grus dri yi legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /bru hi snā na'i gnas su lardza snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyi/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byug cing chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ sman gyi bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bsam gtan dri yis legs bgos chu/

/khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /lardza snā na'i gnas su oṃ kha dhi snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyi/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyi byug cing chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ rin po che'i bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /shes rab dri yi legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyi/ de nas dri'i bum pa thogs te/ chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing / /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri chu drug gi khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi/ /yon tan thams cad ldan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o/ /zhes brjod cing tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu bum chu blug de nas khrus long bzhag la/ bum pa lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pa'i ku sha'i rtsa bas tshigs bcad re re dang bstun/ rten rnams la bum chu 'thor tshul bya/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril sil gdangs dang bcas tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu rten la nas gtor zhing / gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/

/thugs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing / /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur zhing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsungs shing / /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyi pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yi/ /khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur/ /khyed cag sdig pa ma gyur cig /ces brjod cing nyin mo bde legs dang bstun sna tshogs rol mo mdzad/

de nas mchod g.yog pas dri'i bum pa de nyid g.yas dang / khrus long g.yon du khyer la rten gsar rnying thams cad la me long bstan zhing gong bzhin khrus bya/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la sogs gong bzhin brjod cing bkru/ rol mo bya/ de dag sku la sogs sngags dang bcas pas sku phyi/ de nas bum pa/ khrus long / sku phyis/ rdo dril sogs bzhag go /khrus bum gcig las med na rten gsar pa bkru ba man thams cad de nyid kyi bya ba yin no// //spyi don drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ rten rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ shū n+ya tās rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bla ma'i sku gtso bo yin na/ pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha grangs dang mnyam pa rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad na rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad na des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcus do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje ngam dang zhi ba yi/

/gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gri thod 'dzin ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du gtso bo gang yin pa de gong bzhin rgyas par bskyed/ mchod rten ni pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na 'khor lo/ g.yon brgyad na des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa de nyid 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i mchod rten seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i khri'i gdan la/ dang po pad+ma spungs pa'i mchod rten pad+ma brtsegs pa'i bang rim zlum po bzhi dang ldan pa/ gnyis pa byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bang rim gru bzhi pa rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ gsum pa bkra shis sgo mang gi mchod rten bang rim gru bzhi pa rim pa bzhi'i bang rim glo 'bur bzhis mtshan pa la/ phyogs rer sgo bcu drug re dang / bum pa dang bre'i phyogs bzhir sgo res mtshan pa/ bzhi pa cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten phyogs bzhir 'bur bzhi yod pa'i bang rim gru bzhi pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ lnga pa lha babs kyi mchod rten bang rim gru bzhi pa rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyogs bzhir glo 'bur gyi steng du skas gdang gis mtshan par byas pa/ drug pa dbyen sdums mchod rten bang rim bzhi gru bzhi pa'i zur nas bcad pa lta bu'i phyogs re la zur brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ bdun pa sku tshe byin gyi brlabs pa'i mchod rten bang rim zlum po rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ brgyad pa mya 'das mchod rten bang rim dang bral ba ste/ de lta bu'i mchod rten rnams mgur chu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du bam pa zlum po sgo re dang bcas pa/

de'i steng du bre/ de'i steng du gdugs rim pa bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang / dar gyi lda ldi/ dril bu/ zla tshes la sogs pas mtshan par gyur/ de tsam rgyas par brjod pa blos mi 'dod na de nyid 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad tshad dang / mtshan nyid rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ ces brjod kyang rung / de ltar tsha tsha/ khang bu brtsegs pa sogs chos sku'i mchod rten gyi rigs thams cad bsdus pa ltar bya/ de lta bu'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje sogs gong bzhin dang / shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor āṃ las rin po che āṃ gi mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kye rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad pad+ma/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ byang du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las don yod grub pa kye rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/

zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad ral gri/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rigs lnga thams cad rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ chos po ti dang / gzungs ni rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kye rdo rje gong bzhin bskyed/ lha khang / gtsug lag khang sogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rjer gong bzhin bskyed/ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha khang sogs su gyur pa'i nang du gdan lnga'i steng du kye rdor rigs lnga bskyed pa mchod rten bzhin bya/ rdo dril sogs phyag mtshan rnams ni pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa kye rdo rjer gong bzhin bskyed/ khang bzang dang / rta babs dang / ljon shing dang / rdo ring dang / chu mig dang / khron pa la sogs pa rnams ni pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang kye rdo rje gong bzhin bskyed/ thub pa'i sku yin na seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ las gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol ba/ dbu gtsug tor dang bcas shing mtshan dpes spras pa/ sku la 'od zer bye ba brgya stong 'phro ba'i sku can du gyur/ rdo rje 'chang yin na khri gdan gong bzhin la oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/

dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyi spras shing / dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa'i sku yin na gzhan gong 'og thams cad gong dang 'dra la/ mtshan gyi skabs rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kha dang / g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa sogs dang / yum sku mdog dkar mor byed pa tsam mo/ /'di gsum cho ga bsgyur mi dgos/ grub chen brgyad cu sogs bla ma brgyud pa'i sku rnams ni gong bzhin kye rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje yab yum du bskyed/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug sogs kyang bla ma'i khongs su bsdus nas gong bzhin rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pas chog par sems so/ /gzhan bri sku'i gtso bo yi dam lta bu yin zhing / 'khor nyung na rang gi phyag mtshan sa bon las so so'i rnam pa can du bskyed pa'am gong bzhin gtso 'khor thams cad rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje'i rnam par bskyed/ gur zhal sogs sa skya pa'i chos bsrung thun mong ma yin pa rgyud sde zab mo nas gsungs pa rnams so so'i gtor chog bzhin bskyed pa thun mong ma yin pa'am/ thun mong ba ni chos bsrung thams cad gong bzhin mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje yab yum du bskyed/ dkyil 'khor yin na paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi/

rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i nang du lha rnams kyi gdan gtso 'khor gyi bskyed chog sogs shes shing spro na so so'i dkyil chog bzhin bskyed/ de tsam mi nus na pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gtso 'khor thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ zhes pas bskyed/ yang dkyil 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang srung 'khor med pa rnams la phyi rol du 'od zer 'phros pas yongs su bskor ba ces sogs skabs thob dang sbyar nas shes par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa'i lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa bris pa dang / go khrab/ rgyan gos sogs la bgegs bskrad/ bkra shis brjod pa tsam gyis gzhi bdag sogs shing / sbyin bdag la mthun rkyen bsgrub cing 'gal rkyen sel ba dang / yo byad kyi dngos po rnams gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par bsam pa tsam gyis chog la/ gzhan bskyed chog dang rtog bzo'i sgo nas yon bdag gi mgo skor gang yang mi dgos/ srung ba sogs 'khor lo sngags can dang / sku yod pa rnams pad nyi'i gdan la oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang kye rdo rjer gong bzhin bskyed nas zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo bris pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur pa'i nang du pad nyi'i gdan la sngags rnams dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med kye rdo rjer gong bzhin bskyed/

sku yod na oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rjer gong bzhin bskyed pa sogs rigs 'gre skabs thob dang bstun nas rnam dpyod kyis dpyad par bya'o/ /de ltar lha rnams bskyed tshar ba dang / lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod cing bsam la byin gyi rlobs// //spyi don bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba la gsum/ spyang ba dngos/ bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug zhugs bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo dril dang / slob dpon gyis spos bzung / rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rang 'dra'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ de nas gdangs dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/

/chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod la spyan drangs nas spos bzhag gnyis pa bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa ni/ ngag tu ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces brjod la las thams cad pa'i sngags a mṛ ta bzlas/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug cing / dril sil rol mo drag tu bya/ de nas mchod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyi ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ḥ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /de srid mchod pa bdag bgyis na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃḥ zhes pas gdan phul/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa/

/tshim byed yid 'ong ldan pa 'di/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ldan/ /chu dang thang skyes yid byung 'di/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu kun nas bdug spos 'di/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di 'am phyogs rnams na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas/ /yon tan kun ldan gang yin de/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di 'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de/ /thub dbang la ni dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston zhing / /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ ces brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo bya/ zhes pa'i mchod pa 'di/ rje btsun rin po ches mchod pa rnam lnga go rim bzhin yod kyang / deng sang bla ma rnams kun rig bzhin 'don bya bde ba la dgongs nas gong bzhin mdzad pas de ltar du bkod pa la/ bla med rdo rje theg pa ste rol mo'i tshigs bcad 'di don gsal bzhin/ gsum pa dgug zhugs bya ba la gnyis kyi dang po rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang nye bar dgug oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa gzhug oṃ badz+ra bait+ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ zhes pas ro gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam la/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing bstim mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkha' gang ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis spos dang / gzhan dpon slob tshang mas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad na/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs nas lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyi ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin rlabs shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la gong bzhin dgug bzhugs bya'o// //spyi don brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhes brjod cing bsam/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyi mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyi oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus lha rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag pa yar lud pa las rten ngo shes pa rnams la rang rang gi rigs bdag dang / ngo mi shes pa'i mang po yod na thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan zhes brjod cing rgyas gdab bo//

//spyi don dgu pa mchod bstod bya zhing gtor ma btang ba ni/ mchod stegs kyi mar me rnams sbar/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta'i bar gyi byin gyis rlabs la/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wa ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas brjod cing mthar se gol gtog pa nas/ shap+ta'i mthar rol chen rgyun dkrol/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs dbang chu mdzes rgyan bzhin gdangs dang bcas pa dang / de nas dril sil dang bcas pas mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs de nyid lnga pa dang / hūm̐/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par de nyid la/ /gzugs can rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/

/phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /ting 'dzin chen po phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung / /bya sgrub ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o/ /zhes dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'phrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'phrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang / /chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyi phongs gyur pa/ /ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas/ /zhi ba rin chen mchog gling skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyod la kun nas 'dud/ /sems can las kyi chu bor grur nub rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /sh+lau ka gcig sogs gdangs dang bcas pas bstod la/ gtor ma btang ba ni/ gtor ma rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ ha hoḥhrīḥzhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod la/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin zhes sogs dang / dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang /

'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje shar du dbang phyug chen po zhes sogs dang / srin po'i dur khrod kyi 'og gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ zhes sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug bya/ dbang lha spyan drangs te mchod cing gsol ba btab pa dang / dbang bskur ba rnams gtor chog ltar byas la/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyi dbur rgyan par bsam la/ mchod gtor 'bul ba nas mchod bstod phrin las 'chol ba'i bar gtor chog ltar bya ba mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma 'bul tshul lo/ /'di bzhin lha sta gon gyi skabs su'ang dgos/ de nas bde mchog sogs yi dam gzhan dang / gur zhal sogs sngar gtor ma 'bul bzhin pa thams cad/ bskang ba byed par spro nas rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya/ de nas bstod pa/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar so so'i phyag len bzhin bya/ thun gtor 'bul dgos na'ang phul la// //spyi don bcu pa snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya ba ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bcug pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ nangs par dngos gzhi'i dus su rten byin gyis rlabs pa'i phyir 'byon par zhu'o zhes snyan gsan 'bebs pa ste rdo dril dang spos 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas pa'am gdangs med kyang rung ste/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das/

/rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye ba/ kun gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i phyir/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag gi /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis/ /rab gnas nangs par bgyid par 'tshal/ /tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa/ /kun gyi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ spos bzhag dril bu rgyun dkrol rdo rje snying kha dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyid par 'tshal na/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams sang nangs par byon zhing rten byin gyi rlabs te bdag la dngos grub kyi mchog stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa spyi'i tshig yin/ don he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes sam/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes rab gnas kyi rten gyi gtso bo gang yin de'i mtshan nas brjod pa'o/ /de nas mar me dang / zhal zas sogs gsar pa ji ltar rigs pa phul zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin du sngags thog mtha' 'dra ba la pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis sngags mchod sna tshogs rol mo dang bcas pas phul/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lnga pa dang / phyag byar 'os pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod// //spyi don bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyis stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces dang / khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo brkyang ste rtse sprad pa gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor zlog ste/

hūm̐ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ rten gyi ye shes pa thams cad sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la gong bzhin sngags mchod bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /kha cig ye shes pa brtan bzhugs thams cad de nyid kyi/ nam mkhar mi 'degs pa man ngag yin zer ba ni snyan gsan phab pa'i dgos pa ma shes par zad do zhes snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rab rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor gsungs so// //spyi don bcu gnyis pa rten dgab pa ni/ dar la sogs pa'i na bza' ser pos rten rnams mi mngon par dgab/ bris sku'i zhal khebs rnams kyang dgab la/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ya ā hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang / las thams cad pa'i sngags a mṛ ta lan gsum brjod pas bsrungs/ de ni rgyal po rgyal sar ma thon pa rgyal srid la mi dbang ba ltar/ rab gnas ma zin pa de mchod pa'i 'os ma yin no zhes bstan pa yin no/ /zhes don gsal las gsungs// //spyi don bcu gsum pa bdag bsrungs ba ni/ de ltar rab gnas kyi sta gon zin pa dang / dkyil 'khor mjug gi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsang sbyangs byin gyis rlabs te/ phyi nang yid byung bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyi nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs/ rdul tshon yin na gshegs gsol ma tshar gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol sogs dang / rten med pa la gshegs gsol/ dam tshig rang la bsdu ba/ rang kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyis bdag bsrung ba/ dge ba 'di yi nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis rnams sgrub mchod ltar byas la/ spyod lam dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs bya'o/ /de dag gis ni rab gnas kyi sta gon gyi cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to/

/nub gsum pa ni dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi gnyis pa rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa/ gtor ma sogs sgrub mchod ltar so so'i phyag len bzhin ma tshang ba med par bsham/ rab gnas kyi gshoms ni mchod pa rnams sta gon las mi nyung zhing rgya che ba dang / khrus stegs kyi sku/ khrus long gi yi ge bri ba/ khrus bum brgyad/ rdzas gsum/ sbyang chas sogs sta gon skabs bzhin dang / gzhan yang khrus stegs kyi g.yon phyogs gang 'os su mnga' dbul gyi stegs ras la sogs pa la ri rab gling bzhi bri ba ni phyogs re re la cha lnga lnga ste bcu par byas la/ dbus kyi cha gnyis la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ phyi rol gyi zur nas bskor la lcags ri bya/ phyogs bzhi nas byang chub mchod rten gyi bang rim ltar je chung je chung byas pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser po/ zur bzhi'i re mig rnams sngon po'am nag po/ de'i phyi rol lcags ri'i nang rgya mtsho mtshon byed chu ris bris pa'i steng shar du zla gam gsum/ lhor sog kha gsum/ nub tu zlum po gsum/ byang du gru bzhi gsum ste gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ de dag gi shar du dpal ye/ 'khor lo/ lhor pad+ma/ rgyal mtshan/ nub tu gdugs dang bum pa/ byang du dung dang gser nya ste bkra shis rtags brgyad/ phyi'i lcags ri sngon po rnams bri'o/ /de ltar bris pa de nyid ras la sogs pa gzhi bzang po'i steng du bkram pa'i dbus kyi pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du gser ram/ dngul gyi phor pa la sogs pa'i rin po che'i snod kyi nang du 'bru sna tshogs dang / gser dngul/ byu ru/ mu tig sogs rin po che ci 'byor pas phyur mor bkang ba bzhag slob dpon gyi mdun ji ltar rigs par stegs la/ rten la dbang bskur ba'i rdo dril/ dbu rgyan/ mnga' dbul gyi tsa ka li rgyab yig can gang dgos/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang /

chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma che ba stod gru gsum/ smad zlum po pad+mas bskor ba la nyi zla nor bu me ri sogs so so'i phyag len bzhin bzos pa gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams kyi 'khris gang bder bzhag tsa ru'i bza' ba phyag len bzhin bsham pa'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i bsdoms ni/ tho rangs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod/ /rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /ring srel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ /rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya/ /gsol btab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya/ /de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang / /sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi'o/ /zhes pa ltar don bcu gsum gyi spyi don dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ sang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ gos ser po la sogs pa gsar pa gon/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bsgrub ste lhag chad kha bskang ba'i bar rdzogs par byas la rnam rgyal dang / las bum gnyis dri bzang gi chus kha gsos la bum bskyed mdzad/ de nas khrus bum rnams kyang kha gsos te las bum gyi chu 'thor ba sogs sngar bzhin du bsgrub/ khrus bum gcig las med na rdo rje gzungs thag de'i steng du bzhag cing / gzungs thag mchu gcig po la bskor ba tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan sngags bzla ba tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan sngags bzla ba sogs cho ga rnams 'dra/ de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang rdzogs par blang ngo // //spyi don gnyis pa rten sbyang ba dang / spyi don gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bya'o// //spyi don bzhi pa ring srel gzhug pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ring srel lam/ rigs sngags chen mo dang / rten 'brel snying po dang / so so thar pa rnams gur gum dang / gi wang bsres pas bris la/ sku gzugs rnams kyi dbu'i rgyab phyogs su bug pa yod na gzhug

bug pa med pa'am/ mchod rten dang sku gzugs la sngar bzhugs zin na ring srel mi dgos la/ gzungs dang so so thar pa bris pa dbu'am bre la gdags/ bris sku la sogs pa'i dbu'i rgyab tu bri bar gsungs kyang / deng sang phyag len la dpon slob thams cad bsgrigs 'don mdzad de/ oṃ sarba bi d+yā swā hā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du yang sdom pa legs/ /zhes lan gcig brjod pa'o// //spyi don lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpon slob rnams snam sbyar la sogs pa gyon nas langs te/ lag tu me tog dang rol mo thogs nas/ de'i yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ spos kyi bdug 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags sogs brjod/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang / mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang yang dag par ldan pa/

de'i skyon gyis nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing / bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / tshul khrims gsum dang / ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bslab pa gsum dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pas/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang / shes bya'i yul thams cad la mnga' brnyes pas nyon mongs pa ma lus pa la sogs pa rnams spangs pa dang / bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yang dag par brgyan pa dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par mdzes pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa dang / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gi rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye ta thā ga ta ya a ra ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes dang / rab gnas kyi lha gang yin pa ngo shes pa rnams kyi sngags dang / rang yi dam gyi lha'i sngags kyang cung zad gcig bzla'o/ /rjes dran bzhi po 'di lan gsum mdzad de/ sems bskyed kyi tshig thams cad lan gsum re 'don pa gzhung du ma nas 'byung ba la/ 'di sems bskyed kyi tshig tu slob dpon zhi ba snying pos bshad ces rje rdo rje 'chang gi rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor gsungs so/

/de nas stan la tsog pur 'dug lag pa'i mthil gnyis bsdams pa'i bar du nas cung zad bzung la/ byams pa dang snying rje/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems cung zad bsgom ste/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi ba de'i nus༞ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo / /'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i thams cad༞ thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas bcad do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang phyir rgol ba dag dang / lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho skam par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang des pa la bzud do/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la rtser stsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me phung gzhil bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon rtse rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ /bden pa la gzud do/ /phrag dog gi tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang / bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsal zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes dpon slob thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu brjod cing lag na yod pa'i nas rnams gtor/ rnam sbyar sogs bzhag nas gral la 'dug go/ //spyi don drug pa rten bskyed pa/ /spyi don bdun pa ye shes pa sbyangs nas bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug zhug bya ba/ /spyi don brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa rnams sta gon bzhin no/ /'on kyang spyan drangs pa'i skabs su rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rang gi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang / sta gon gyi rten gyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang / bgegs bskrad kyi dus ye shes sems dpa' rnams kyi zhes mang tshig tsam 'jug/ //spyi don dgu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas rten dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa la las bum gyi chu ku shas gtor zhing / oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rten dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gcig dang / gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya phyag rgya dang bcas pas rten dang dbang rdzas la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi/ /khyed kyi 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa bteg nas/ rten rnams la nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon gyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing bum chu ting la sogs pa'i snod du blug de nyid mchod g.yog pas rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur nas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/

lus thams cad gang / mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyi mchod pa lngas mchod/ rten dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan la las bum gyi chu gtor/ swa bhā wa brjod/ rten dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par gong ltar spyan drangs te so so la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+ri bhā wa sogs dang / rnam rgyal bum chu ku shas dbang rdzas la gtor ba 'di man thams cad la 'dra bar byas te dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra shā li hoḥ

zhes brjod cing dbu rgyan rten rnams la 'bul tshul byas la/ mchod g.yog pa la gtad de rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag 'di man la rnam rgyal bum chu ku shas rten rnams la 'thor tshul dang / oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ 'di tsam gyis chog puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ rten dang dbang rdzas rdo rje la las bum gyi chu dang / swa bhā wa sogs rten dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med kye rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad pad+ma/ g.yon brgyad de yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod cing / thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs la so sor bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyis dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas 'od du zhu ste rdo rjer gyur pa sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rten rnams la rdo rje 'bul tshul byas la/ mchod g.yog pa la gtad de rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag rnam rgyal bum chu gtor zhing badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyi gong bzhin dbang bskur/

'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ rten dang dbang rdzas dril bu la las bum gyi chu gtor zhing swa bhā wa sogs/ rten dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa kye rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad ral gri/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub pa kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs la so sor bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyis dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur rgyan/ dbang rdzas 'od du zhu ste dril bur gyur sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis dril bu thogs la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing dril bu sil la rten rnams la 'bul tshul byas/ mchod g.yog pa la gtad de rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag rnam rgyal bum chu gtor zhing / badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyis gong bzhin dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ rten rnams la las bum gyi chu dang / swa bhā wa sogs rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/

phyag g.yas brgyad 'khor lo/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad dang kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs la gau rī ā kar+ṣas rten rnams la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis rang gi rdo dril gnyis lag pa g.yas pas phyogs gcig dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing rten thams cad la gsang mtshan btags par bsam la rdo dril mdun du bzhag rnam rgyal bum chu gtor zhing / badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyis gong bzhin dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbur brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rten rnams mi dmigs te stong pa gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rten rnams rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje'i snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang /

dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi mdun gyi rdo rje blangs la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing rdo rje gsor la rten rnams kyi phyag g.yas par phul pa'i mos pa bya ba ste slob ma'i dbang ngo / /slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyi rlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes brjod cing dbang bskur bar bsam/ /gsang dbang ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo byang chub kyi sems rten gyi ljags thog tu bzhag par bsam ste/ slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas thur mas bdud rtsi blangs la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hoḥm hā su kha zhes brjod cing rten la phul bar bsam la/ ting la sogs par blugs te mchod g.yog pas rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs kha nas ye shes kyi rig ma sprul te phul bar bsam pa phul bar bsam la/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes brjod/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes brjod cing dbang don rnams thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par bsam mo/ /de ltar na dbang bzhi bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan pa sta gon bzhin no// //spyi don bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ mchod pa'i mar me ma sbar ba rnams sbar/ zhal zas dang mar me gsar pa yod na'ang phul zhing /

mchod pa rnams kha gsos la mchod pa byin gyis rlabs nas/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad dang bcas pa/ de nyid lnga pa sogs bstod pa rnams sta gon bzhin bya'o/ /kha cig spyan dbye ma byas par mchod bstod la mi dbang bas mchod bstod mi byed pa man ngag yin zer ba ni mun sprul du zad de/ de lta na sta gon gyi skabs su rten rnams lha so sor bskyed pa la mchod bstod rgyas par bshad pa de yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ der spyan dbye ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang pos gsungs// //spyi don bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba ni/ gser drug snam las mi chung ba'i thur mas/ dngul gyi gong bur bzhag pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi blang ba'am/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon phra mo zhig blangs la spyan gyi thad kar byug ces gsungs kyang / phyag len la de dag mos pa tsam ma gtogs dngos su mi mdzad/ gser gyi mig thur ma 'byor na thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du rdo rje bzung la/ spyan gyi thad dkar byug tshul bya zhing / kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan gyi dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ ye shes kyis spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa gyur cig ces pa lan gsum brjod// //spyi don bcu gnyis pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba gdab pa ni/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga gong bzhin sngags mchod dang / de nyid lnga pas bstod/ de nas dpon slob thams cad bzhengs te mgrin gcig tu/ ye dharma lan gsum brjod pas byin gyi rlabs pa'i me tog bzung la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gzugs kyi rten 'di dag la sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo dang / rten la me tog gi char dbab/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swāhā/ yang yang brjod/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas so/ /de ltar lan gsum du byas la/ de nas zhal bsgyur ba ni/ bla ma sogs rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rjer bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ bla ma so so'i sku'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ chos po ti 'od dpag med zhu ba las lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid chos dkon mchog dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge ā li kā li'i rnam pa glegs bam gyi gzugs ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ phyag mtshan rnams kyi mi bskyod pa zhu ba las phyag mtshan so so'i dbyibs dang kha dog ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ khang bzang rta babs sogs kyi rnam par snang mdzad de zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i khang bzang sogs rang rang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ gzhan bris sku'i yi dam gtso 'khor rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ yi dam so so'i sku'i rnam pa bris pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ chos srung rnams gtor chog bzhin bskyed na zhal bsgyur mi dgos/ mi bskyod par bskyed na mi bskyod pa rnams 'od du zhu ba las chos srung gi sku'i rnam pa bris pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso 'khor rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bris pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/

srung ba sogs kyi 'khor lo'i sngags 'od dpag med du bskyed pa 'od zhu ste yi ge ā li kā li'i rnam par gyur/ srung ba'i sku rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu bris pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ de bzhin du bris 'bur thams cad la rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /yi dam/ sangs rgyas/ chos srung gi sku sogs so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed pa rnams ni zhal bsgyur mi dgos so// //spyi don bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba la bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten gsar pa'i mdun du mar me zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang / mchod pa snying pa rnams kha gsos la/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ ni wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa byin gyi rlabs la gdangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ /zhes dang / pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du stong gsum 'di'am༞ lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ༞ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas me tog༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ pā d+yaṃ gnas su puṣ+paṃ༞ stong gsum༞
