lha rdzas bdug spos༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ puṣ+paṃ gyis gnas su dhū paṃ༞ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas snang gsal༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ dhu paṃ gyi gnas su dī paṃ༞ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas dri mchog༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ dī paṃ gyi gnas su gan+dhaṃ༞ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas zhal zas༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ gan+dhaṃ gyi gnas su nai wi d+yaṃ༞ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas rol mo༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ dharma ra ṇi sogs brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo rgya cher bya/ de nas oṃ las rin chen sna bdun sprul ste/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya wa brta ya hoḥ zhes brjod cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ tsakra'i gnas su ma ṇi༞ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /ma ṇi'i gnas su wastī༞ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /wastī'i gnas su ma hā ta༞ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg pa rab zhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ma hā ta'i gnas su hasti༞ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog

/hasti'i gnas su tu raṃ ga༞ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khaṅga rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ de nas 'dod yon lnga ni gdangs dang bcas pas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos rab gnas lha la bdag 'bul gyis/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga rū paṃ kā ma gu ṇa pu dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ /bzhes shig༞ /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ rū pa'i gnas su shap+ta dang rol chen bya/ phyogs dus kun nas tsan dan sbrul snying dang / /a kar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ shap+ta'i gnas su gan+dha/ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ gan+dha'i gnas su rā sa༞ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes dang / gos zungs phul te/ de rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes/ /bsam gyi mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'gag med seṅge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung la༞ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/

/bde gsal mi rtog ngang tshul can/ /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la༞ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / bla ma ched du gtad pa'i sku yod cing shes na de'i sku bstod sogs skabs thob dang sbyar nas byed/ gzhan yi dam sogs lha so so'i sgo nas bstod shes shing byed par spro na'ang bya/ de tsam mi shes na/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' mtshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / chos po ti sogs la/ dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mchod rten la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi/ /sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /chos sku rang bzhin can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /sku bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / thams cad kyi thun mong du snang stong rdo rje dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs sta gon bzhin dang / mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi thugs rje can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dag pa'i chos mchog can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas dpe med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung /

/smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don bsgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub stsol mdzad pa/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen te/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nye bar mkho bas mnga' dbul ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po rten thams cad la spyir mnga' dbul ba'i sdoms ni/ dkyil 'khor khrus dang na bza' rgyan/ /rnam lnga rin chen bdun dang bcud/ /gdugs sogs dag ni spyi yi 'o/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po dkyil 'khor ni/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ri rab dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bris pa de/ rten rnams la dngos su phul bar bsam la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / slob dpon gyis rgyab yig bklags la gdangs bcas pas/ sa gzhi spos kyi byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhis legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra su re khe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ mnga' dbul stegs kyi rin po che'i snod 'bru sogs kyis bkangs pa'i mthar rim pa bzhin bkod pa mdzes par gcal du bkram par bya'o/ /gnyis pa khrus ni/

khrus bum bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /spos mchog rnams kyi thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gong bzhin gtad/ gsum pa na bza' ni/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / byang sems khyim pa'i cha lugs can dang / mchod rten dang / glegs bam rnams la dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bris pa dngos su dbul bar bsam zhing / kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yangs mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra s+ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku dang / byang chub sems dpa'/ nyan thos sogs rten rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can rnams la ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / dri med mtshan la sgrib gsal mi mnga' yang / /dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa rgyan ni/ rin po che'i prog zhu la sogs pa rgyan mang po bris pa phul bar bsam zhing / rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang / /rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā laṃ kā ra wa pu ṣa ṇi āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ lnga pa 'dod yon lnga ni/ 'dod yon lnga'i gzugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang / /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis/

/mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ drug pa rin chen bdun ni/ rgyal srid sna bdun bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bshams shing yid kyis sprul ste phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi bzad gter la longs spyod shog /oṃ badz+ra sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ bdun pa bcud ni/ rin po che'i snod lngar/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ rin po che lnga/ snying po lnga rnams blug pa'am gzugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes lnga lnga brnyes pa la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pañtsa pañtsa bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ brgyad pa gdugs sogs ni/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla bre dang / rol mo la sogs pa'i gzugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang / /ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad pa rnams ni rten spyi la 'bul ba'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu rten so so la mnga' dbul ba'i sdoms ni/ spu gri 'dreg spyod so mang dang / /smar gzer tshems shing spabs bzhar ro/ /zhes pa ltar drug las/ dang po ni/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can rnams la gser gyi spu gri bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / dbu skra dang zhal spu 'dreg pa'i tshul byas la/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang /

/gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spangs phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi 'dreg spyad phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mu le āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gnyis pa 'dreg spyad ni/ gser gyi 'dreg spyad bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ sen mo 'dreg pa'i tshul bya zhing / zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid yang skyon bral yang / /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi/ /sen mo'i 'dreg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra nā gats+tshe da dzi na āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gsum pa so mang ni/ rten sangs rgyas longs sku'i cha lugs can rnams dang / byang sems khyim pa'i tshul can rnams la gser gyi so mangs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ dbu skra shad pa'i tshul bya zhing / dbu skra rin chen lcang lo ma dkrugs shing / /mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms skyon bral yang / /bdag blo sbyangs phyir rkyen dang mtshams pa 'di/ /phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badz+ra sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa smar gzer ni/ gser gyi smrar 'jab bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ shangs dang / zhal spu 'thog pa'i tshul bya zhing / dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims legs 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba bsgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang / /mos pas 'dzin spyad dam pa phul ba yis/ /'gro bas bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ lnga pa tshems shing ni/ gser dngul las byas pa'i tshems shing bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ tshems kyi srub rnams drud pa'i tshul bya zhing / dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang ba'i tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang / /bdag cag dad pas tshems shing dbul lags kyi/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog

/oṃ badz+ra dan+ta sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ drug pa spabs bzhar ni/ snyan 'dru ba'i thur ma bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ snyan 'dru ba'i tshul bya zhing / snyan bsrings mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bos dag na yang / /dag byed 'di ni bdag gi 'bul lags kyi/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thos par shog /oṃ badz+ra kar+ṇa sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ sprul sku rnams la so mang dang / longs sku rnams la spu gri mi 'bul ba tsam mo/ /mchod rten la bye brag tu mnga' dbul kyi sdoms ni/ srog shing 'khor lo cod paṇa 'phan/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba gdan/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po srog shing ni/ srog shing bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos yun ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig zhes brjod cing gtad/ gnyis pa 'khor lo ni/ gdugs rim pa bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pra ba dha nā ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur cig zhes brjod cing gtad/ gsum pa cod paṇa ni/ dar gyi cod paṇa bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pa taṃ ka laṃ pa ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad dus thams cad du dar gyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub la sogs pa mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / de dag gi mchod rten dang / sku gzugs dang /

gsung rab la sogs pa dag la mchod pa byed par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa 'phan ni/ dar 'phan sna tshogs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pa taṃ ke swāhā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ lnga pa rgyan ni/ chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ kum bhi ra dh+wa dzā ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi 'dzin mi gtong bas bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ drug pa gdugs ni/ gdugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ bh+ra ma ṇā ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ bdun pa phreng ba ni/ me tog sna tshogs bris pa'i phreng ba dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rat+na mā la traṃ/ na masatra ya dhi/ a hu ga ta pra tiṣ+ṭhi ta puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+yā thā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te/ sku lta bas mchog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ brgyad pa gdan ni/ rin po che la sogs pa 'og gi tshig rigs dang mthun pa'i gdan bris pa'i dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ puṇ+yā dha ri dza ye swāhā/ sems can thams cad kyi gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan pa glang po che'i gdan dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seṅge'i gdan dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang / dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang / thams cad du thogs pa med pa stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha' lding gi gdan dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba nor bu rin po che'i gdan dang / chags pa'i skyon thams cad spangs pa pad+ma'i gdan dang /

rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i gdan thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ glegs bam la sogs pa gsung rab la bye brag tu mnga' dbul ba'i sdoms ni/ bzhugs khri dang ni na bza' dang / /glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po bzhugs khri ni chos kyi khri seṅges bteg pa'i dar zab bkab pa bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rin chen du ma las grub seṅge'i khri/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs gos kyi bkab pa 'di/ /spros bral gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā sa nā ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gnyis pa na bza' ni/ rten khebs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyangs phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gsum pa glegs shing ni/ glegs shing gnyis bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang / /thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i/ /nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dgab bya ba/ /phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pradzñā u pa ya a dā ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa glegs thag ni/ chos kyi sku rags pod long dang bcas bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang / /ye shes chen por ro gcig gyur pa ltar/ /glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad phul ba yis/ /'gro ba ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pusta ka ban+dha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad la/ mchod g.yog pas mnga' dbul gyi stegs kyi steng du mdzes par bkod/ gsum pa sbyin sreg gam tsa ru'i bza' bas mnga' dbul ba ni/

sbyin sreg byed na kye rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg nas bshad pa'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bzhin so so'i phyag len ltar gtsug lag khang sogs gnas khang yangs shing du ba'i skyon mi 'byung na khyams smad la sogs pa gang 'os dang / yang gnas de nyid du mi yod na phyi rol steng la sogs pa gang 'os su bya/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i skabs su rab gnas kyi rten gyi gtso bo bla ma'i sku yin na rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje dang / mchod rten dang / lha khang yin na rnam snang kye rdo rje dang / gsung rab glegs bam yin na 'od dpag med kye rdo rje sogs skabs thob dang bstun nas thab tu spyan drangs la/ mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i 'brus gtso byas pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ bdag dang yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir du dūr ba sogs kyi sbyin sreg bya zhing / 'o thug bsgrub pa sogs byed par spro na/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi yig cha bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / bde legs rgya mtsho gnyis la sogs par lta bar bya'o/ /deng sang phyag len la sbyin sreg mi mdzad pas ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon cung zad tsam yang med de/ rje btsun rin po ches ma grub na snod bzang po'i nang du lha bshos chen po rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa bzhag la sogs gsungs pas/ deng sang phyag len la tsa ru'i bza' ba kho na mdzad pas/ snod bzang po'i nang du 'brang rgyas zhos byugs shing mar gyi nyi zla nor bu sogs kyis brgyan pa la dar ser po rgyal mtshan/ dar kha gang tsam btsugs pa'i mthar bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / btung ba sna tshogs pa bsham/ de yang rab/ rab gnas kyi yo lang thams cad dkar gsum mngar gsum kho na la brten dgos te/ rab gnas byas pa'i phan yon 'jig rten gyi khams dang / khyad par gnas de nyid du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i rgyu sdig pa spangs shing dge ba kho na bsgrub dgos pa'i phyir ro/

/yang sbyin bdag gi 'byor pa dang mi bstun kha med shar na/ ched du gtad nas dmigs te bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha skam smug ji ltar rigs pa dang / btung ba yang dge slong rab tu byung ba rnams la zho'am/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la bkras chang du dmigs te chang phor pa re tsam ma gtogs gzi bar mi 'thung / sbyin bdag bzo bo sogs la dgos pa'i sha chang / gnas khang zur pa zhig tu byed pa ma gtogs tsa ru'i bza' ba'i sar mi bsgrig go /de ltar tsa ru'i bza' ba rnams ras la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag mchod g.yog pas las bum nas chu de dag la gtor/ dpon slob thams cad kyi nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum dang / re re'i mjug tu se gol gtog go /de ltar 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor byin gyi rlabs nas rab gnas kyi rten la phul bar bsam zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul ba'i 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /tshar gsum gyi rjes su/ oṃ di bya a na ne sa mā dhi dh+yā na pra ṇa ne swāhā/ zhes brjod/ bza' bca' btung ba rnams kyi phud nas mchod g.yog pas snod gtsang mar cung zad re bsdus la rten gsar pa'i drung du phul/ lhag ma rnams phyi rol du phyag bde ba rnams kyis lhag chad med pa'i mkhos dang / 'brang rgyas shing ngam thur mas bstubs pa ma gtogs gris mi bstub bo/ /bzhi pa bkra shis dang rab gnas kyi sngags kyis mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten gyi gtso bo la gzungs thag btags pa dpon slob kun gyis bzung la rten la nas gtor zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūṃ khaṃ badz+ri bhā wa dṛ dh+ra tiṣ+ṭha bhu khaṃ swāhā/ ces pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang /

de nas dpon slob thams cad kyi dril bu rol mo sogs rgya cher bya zhing / sngags gong bzhin ji ltar rigs pa bzlas so/ /logs bris la sogs pa rdo rje gzungs thag 'dogs mi bde ba'am ma 'byor na med kyang skyon med de/ rje btsun rin po ches/ de ltar ma byas kyang nyes pa med do/ /zhes gsungs pas sngags bzlas shing me tog gtor ba sogs byas pas chog go /de nas dpon slob thams cad kyis dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po dang / /sogs bla ma yi dam chos srung sogs kyi bkra shis rang rang gi blo dang bstun rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa rol mo dang bcas pas me tog gi char dbab bo/ /de nas sngags tsam gyis chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa dang / bstod pa dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ snang stong rdo rje sogs kyi bstod par bya'o/ /de nas mjug gi cho ga la bsdoms ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsngo/ /dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blangs/ /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/ /yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod/ /rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo/ /slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya/ /slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod/ /rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug ston no/ /zhes pa ltar don bcu gsum las/ spyi don dang po gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ yi dam chos srung sogs la rab gnas kyi sta gon gyi skabs ltar rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar byas la/ spyi don gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i rten sogs chos skyong gang la gtad par 'dod pa de la gtor ma sbyin nas bka' bsgo ba yin pas/ chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma de nyid yi dam gyi gtor bsngo'i dus gtor ma thams cad byin rlabs rgyas pa grub zin kyang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ ces bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang bcas byin rlabs bsdus pa dran par byas la/

mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs gur zhal gang rigs kyi gtor chog ltar bskyed cing gtor ma phul la phrin las bcol/ de nas bdag gi rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di la/ bsrung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis bsrung ba dang / skyong bar gyis shig ces bsgo/ chos skyongs de nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i go bkon nas nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par byin rlabs pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas bdag gi bka' las mi 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir rdo rje thogs la mgo bor bzhag pa'i tshul bya zhing dam la bzhag par bsam la/ ngag tu rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis rlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /'jigs 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /oṃ mahā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang / bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / rten 'di la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig ces bka' bsgo zhing dam la bzhag go /chos skyong bsgo ba rje btsun rin po ches nag po chen po la zhes gsungs pas sa skya pa rnams gur zhal gang rigs la mdzad dgos so/ /gtor ma sbyin pa'i skabs su sbyin bdag gi blo dang bstun bskang gso byas nas/ bsgrub khang gi steng du gtor ma 'bul dgos na 'di'i mtshams sam gtor ma sbyin pa'i rjes la dpon slob rnams bzhengs te pu tra bskul/ steng du spyi btab kyi gtor ma phul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma sogs so so'i phyag len bzhin grub nas 'og tu gral la 'khod pa dang / /spyi don gsum pa dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ ras bris yin na bzhugs nas mdzad/ rdul tshon yin na dpon slob rnams bzhengs te dkyil 'khor la bskor nas slob dpon shar du gnas pas/

mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyi rlabs te/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ lha dgu'i sa bon gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs rol mo dang bcas pas yid byung bstod pa rnams phyag len bzhin bya zhing / 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la dngos grub blang ngo / /spyi don bzhi pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ ras bris yin na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes sogs kyi mthar/ khyad par du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes sogs dang / de nas gtor mgron gyi rten sogs med pa rnams la gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba sogs bkra shis kyi bar bya/ rdul tshon yin na bum pa rnams khyams kyi steng du bzhag gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas la/ gtor mgron gyin rten med pa'i ye shes pa rnams dang / rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams zhes brjod cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ lag pa gnyis thugs khar bsnol/ thal mo kha phyir bstan pa'i mtheb srin gyis se gol byas te/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na tod ces dang /

oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod cing de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por gshegs/ de na g.yas skor gyi phyogs bzhi rim pa bzhin me ri nas dbus kyi phur khung bar rdo rje rtses ri mo 'then la ci bde bar gshegs su gsol/ rdul tshon rnams mtha' nas rim pas bsdus te za ma tog la sogs pa'i snod du blugs la bskur sti dang bcas te bzhag thig rjes rnams bum chus mtha' nas rim pa bzhin phyis te rjes mi mngon par byas la/ rang nyid kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma'i bar dang / 'gro ba thams cad kye rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /ces brjod/ de nas gral la 'khod de/ /spyi don lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ rang gi mdun ji ltar rigs par gdan ser po'i steng du nas cung zad bkram pa la/ sbyin bdag rnams bos te 'dug du bcug la/ dpon slob rnams kyis bsgrigs 'don byas te/ khyod kyi nga la gang gsol ba'i/ /sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du/ /de dag don ni ngas byas te/ /de rnams don ni bsgrub zin gyis/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par byos/ /zhes dang / khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyi/ rten 'di la khyod kyi zhag bdun gyi bar la mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa'i rgyun mi chad par mchod pa gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /spyi don drug pa yon bdag la shis pa brjod pa ni/ yon bdag la las thams cad pa'i bum chu gtor zhing a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can re re gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas mchod g.yog pas sbyin bdag rnams la me tog nas re bkye/

dpon slob rnams kyi rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs khro bo spyan drangs/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ bden pa brdar ba'i bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis zhes pa'i bar gong drag po'i sbyang ba'i skabs bzhin byas la/ deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces brjod/ yon bdag gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs dkar sogs kyis brab/ rol mo drag tu bya zhing / las thams cad pa'i sngags a mṛ ta dang / sum+bha ni bzlas/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byas la bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad rten dang / bdag sogs sbyin bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis rlabs la/ slob dpon gyis me long bzung nas rten la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / dpon slob thams cad kyis gdangs dang bcas pas/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba la brten nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyi rlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang / bdag sogs sbyin bdag gi thog drangs sems can thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod cing me long mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ mchod g.yog pas dpon slob rnams dang /

sbyin bdag gi lag par reg pa re byas shing skor nas rten gsar pa'i drung du gtad/ de bzhin 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis gi hang 'bul tshul dang / gi hang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yis/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che nor skyong gi sman gi hang phyag tu phul ba la brten nas zhes sogs dang / gi hang gi rdzas la brten nas sogs gong bzhin brjod/ gi hang mchod g.yog pa la gtad cing skor nas rten gyi drung du bzhag yang slob dpon gyi zho thogs la/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi byed shog /gong 'og gong bzhin la/ zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba sogs/ zho'i rdzas la sogs/ zho gtad cing skor nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis dūr ba thogs la/ dūr bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe ni 'phel gyur cig /rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyi rtswa dur ba phyag tu sogs/ dūr ba'i rdzas la sogs/ dūr ba gtad cing bskor nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis bil ba thogs la/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu dag gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig /lha tshangs pas shing thog bil ba phyag tu sogs/ bil ba'i rdzas la sogs/ bil ba gtad cing bskor nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis dung thogs la/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/

/ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /lha'i dbang po brgya sbyin gyi dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu sogs/ dung dkar gyi rdzas sogs/ dung dkar gtad cing skor la rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis li khri thogs la/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du 'dus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pas/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /bram ze dkar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu sogs/ li khri'i rdzas sogs brjod nas/ li khris rang gi dpral bar thig le bya/ mchod g.yog pas thams cad la li khris thig le byas nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis yungs kar thogs la 'bul tshul bya zhing / yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul ba la brten nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyi rlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang / bdag sogs sbyin bdag gi thog drangs sems can thams cad yungs kar gyi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod cing yungs kar mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ dpon slob dang yon bdag la skor rten gyi drung du bzhag tshigs bcad 'di rnams la sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rgyun ji lta ba bzhin yin/ /spyi don bdun pa rab gnas kyi rten la mchod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos byin rlabs bsdus pa byas/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas sngags mchod/ bstod pa rang gi blo dang bstun pa'i rgyas bsdus gang 'os bya/

mchod pa la tshigs bcad byed pa spro na'ang skabs thob dang bstun nas bya/ de nas rten la phyag dang bskor ba ci nus su bya/ zhes pa rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi gsungs pas bskor ba sogs byed par spro na bya/ yang sbyin bdag gi 'dod pa sogs gtsug lag khang dang / dge 'dun gyi sde sogs la rab gnas dgos zer na/ dpon slob thams cad kyis me tog dang rol mo gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyi mi khyab pa thogs nas/ sde la sogs pa'i phyi nas bskor/ rol mo bya zhing / bkra shis kyi tshig dang / rten 'brel snying po dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs 'don bzhin par me tog gtor zhing bskor ba byas la/ nang du sleb nas gral la 'khod de/ /spyi don brgyad pa bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ dpon slob thams cad kyi phyag tu me tog bzung la/ gyur shog gi skabs su rten dang yon bdag la me tog gtor/ de la thog mar thams cad kyi ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis bsngo ba rgyas par don gsal bzhin dang / bsdu na rang gi gang shes bsdus tsam bya/ da lan 'dir rje btsun rin po che'i dgongs pa don gsal las cung zad bsdus te brjod na/ dgongs gsol spyi dang mthun/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos dkon mchog gi rten la rab tu gnas pa sogs legs par bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa chos kyi dbyings su mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par༞ bdag cag rnams dang sbyin bdag rnams kyi gtso byas sems can thams cad la ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug par༞

da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad bsgrub kyi sgo nas 'dzin par mdzad pa thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring bar༞ rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las 'gro don dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par༞ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel zhing chos spyod bcu'i bsgrub pa khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par༞ gzhan yang 'di ltar du bsgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du yang mi khom pa brgyad spangs pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob par༞ mi'i lus kyang rigs bzang ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cig longs spyod che ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu༞ de bzhin du tshe ring ba rnams kyi༞ nad med pa༞ shes rab che ba༞ skal ba bzang ba༞ dad pa che ba༞ rigs mtho ba༞ de ltar gyur nas kyang dam pa'i chos spyod pa la spro zhing skal ba dang ldan par༞ lan dang rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa'i sbyin pa rlabs po che gtong nus par༞ 'khor bar skye ba la 'dun pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims rlabs po che bsrung nus par༞ sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa rlabs po che bsgom nus par༞ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag sdud pa'i brtson 'grus rlabs po che brtsom nus par༞ gzugs med pa'i khams rnam par gsal bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mu mtha' med pa la mnyam par 'jog nus par༞ thabs snying rje chen po dang mi 'bral zhing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs nus par༞ theg pa chen po zab pa dang rgya che ba ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi 'bral bar༞

dge ba'i bshes gnyen de mnyes par byas nas des rjes su 'dzin par༞ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi rtogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par༞ lam bsgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar༞ sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po byed nus par༞ mthong ba'i chos tshe 'di nyid la'ang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar༞ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu'i gnod pa thams cad༞ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa la sogs pa nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad༞ rgyal po dang / dgra dang / chom rkun la sogs pa mi'i gnod pa thams cad༞ stag dang / seṅge dang / glang po che la sogs pa'i gcan gzan gyi gnod pa thams cad༞ sa g.yo ba dang / skar mda' ltung ba dang / lce 'bab pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad༞ sa chu me rlung la sogs pa 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad༞ rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad༞ mdor na bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing / tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ longs spyod kyi brel ba med pa/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par༞ mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig skye ba kun tu༞ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal༞ phan bde 'byung ba'i༞ byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /gtsug lag rnams ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /'jig rten bde zhing༞ lha yang dus su༞ sman rnams mthu dang༞ sbyin bdag rnams kyi༞ bsod nams stobs chen༞ gzhan yang skye ba༞ bla med bla ma'i༞ ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang / /bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang / /bstan 'dzin bu slob chos spyod 'phel ba yi/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod par bya'o/ /gshin po'i don du yin na gson bsngo'i rjes la rang rang gi blo la gshin bsngo gang yod rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya/

tshigs bcad kyang ji ltar rigs pa brjod do/ /spyi don dgu pa slob dpon mchod pa ni/ sbyin bdag gis slob dpon dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bskur dang / ci 'byor ba'i yon skabs 'dir dbul bar bya'o/ /spyi don bcu pa dga' ston bya ba ni/ rab gnas rgyas par bya ba'i don du dpon slob rnams la dga' ston bsnyen bskur rgyas par bya zhing / sngar gyi tsa ru'i bza' ba lha la phul ba'i lhag ma'i 'brang rgyas kyi zan mchod g.yog pas dpon slob rnams la phul zhing / bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /zo zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing drang / gzhan bzo bo dang / grogs byed pa dang / zhal lta ba dang / nye 'khor sogs gnas khang de nyid dam/ gzhan du yang rung ste/ dga' ston rgya che bar bya zhing / glu len pa dang / gar byed pa la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i yan lag phun sum tshogs par bya/ bkra mi shis pa'i gtam dang spyod pa sogs cung zad tsam yang ma byung ba bya dgos te/ rten 'brel gyi che ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyi don bcu gcig pa slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mjug dang 'brel ba yin pas/ dge ba 'di yi nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /sogs smon lam dang / dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sogs kye rdor gyi bkra shis rgyas pa dang / gzhan yang bla ma yi dam/ chos srung / nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis gang shes dang / nyin mo bde legs sogs rol mo dang bcas pa bya zhing / bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba bzhin du spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal dam pa thob pa gcig tu gyur cig ces brjod cing / rten dang rdul tshon yin na dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol byas pa'i shul rnams su me tog gi char dbab cing /

yon mchod thams cad bkra shis par bya'o/ /spyi don bcu gnyis pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ dpon slob rnams kyis mnga' dbul dang / khrus stegs dang / dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dman pa la sogs pa thams cad bsdu zhing / las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ gtsug lag khang lta bu rab gnas kyi rten gnas de khar bzhugs pa yin na zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rnams kha gsos shing rgyas par 'bul/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod ro rnams phongs pa dang / mgon med pa'i mi'i 'gro ba la sbyin zhing / khyi dang bya rog sogs la ni lhag par dkor du 'gyur bas mi sbyin par bshad do/ /spyi don bcu gsum pa sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir mtshan mo zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya zhing / ma grub na yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla bar gsungs kyang / deng sang phyag len la sbyin sreg mi mdzad cing / yig brgya gsung ba'ang bdag rmongs pas ma nges kyang / dpon slob thams cad kyi yi ge brgya pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa sogs lhag chad kha bskang bar bsam la brjod par bya'o/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas pa nub gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i lugs yongs su rdzogs par bstan zin to// //rab gnas kyi sta gon dang / dngos gzhi rnams bdag 'jug blangs pa'i rjes su byed par rje btsun rin po che'i don gsal dang / rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho las gsal bar gsungs shing / bzang drug las kyang 'gal med du gsungs pa dang / cho ga'i lag len kyang cung bde ba cig yongs kyi 'dug pas gong bzhin bkod pa lags/ yang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chu mdzes rgyan du rab gnas bzang drug gi dngos bstan bzhin/ rab gnas kyi dngos sta gnyis ka sgrub mchod zin pa dang / bdag 'jug gi gong du mdzad par bshad pas/ rang rang so so'i phyag len bzhin dang /

blo la gang bde byas pas chog lha sta gon gyi nyin rab gnas kyi sta gon mi byed par/ dngos gzhi dang po'i nyin rab gnas kyi sta gon byed par/ gong ma'i yig cha de dag thams cad bshad pas/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyi dgongs gzhi chug pa rang zhig mdzad 'tshal/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba nub gnyis ma'i lugs bshad par bya ste/ de la sta gon du gnas pa dang / dngos gzhir gnas pa'o/ /spyi don dang po sta gon la rten 'brel gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa nas/ cho ga la 'jug pa'i bar gong bzhin shes par byas nas/ sta gon dngos la don bcu gsum las/ dang po legs bshams ni/ gnas khang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba phyag brdar bya ba sogs nas/ mchod gtor rang rang gi phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i bar gong bzhin/ slob dpon mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs par rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ gos zungs/ 'thor nas/ bum gdan steng du rnam rgyal dang / las bum/ khrus bum gcig bsgrub grogs pa rnams la rdo dril/ nang mchod/ gos zungs/ gzhan yang rnga cha langs/ dung sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bsham/ rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad ni/ rten gsar pa'i mdun du stegs bang rim can la chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams pa nas/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i til rnams phyag len bzhin bshams pa yan gong du bshad pa ltar byas la/ rten gsar pa rnams dar ram/ ras ser pos g.yogs te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ba sogs sta gon bzhin bya/ de nas sang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi langs la/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed pa ni/ gnas yo byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te lam dus rgyas pa ltar nyams su blangs la/ dkyil 'khor bsdus te rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal la gnas par bya ba rnams bdag bskyed pa'o/

/gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis dbang chu ltar bsgrub nas/ khrus bum bsgrub pa/ bzhi pa rten sbyang ba/ lnga pa bkru zhing phyi ba/ drug pa rten bskyed pa/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa/ dgu pa mchod bstod bya zhing gtor ma btang ba/ bcu pa snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya ba/ bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba/ bcu gnyis pa rten dgab pa'i bar cho ga tshig rigs thams cad gong bzhin no/ /bcu gsum pa bdag bsrung ba ni/ de ltar rab gnas kyi sta gon zin pa dang / yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes dang / rang nyid kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma'i bar gyi bdag bsrung ba/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan sogs kyis bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa spyi 'gro ltar byas la/ spyod lam dang / nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs bya ba ste nub dang po sta gon gyi bya ba bstan zin to// //spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mchod gtor bshams pa sogs gong bzhin/ de nas stegs ji ltar rigs pa la ras sogs dkar po gtsang ma bkab la/ 'bru gang 'byor gcal du bkram pa'i steng du man+ḍal la lha dgu'i tshom bu bkod pa dbus su mañdzi khar bzhag de'i mdun du chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bshams pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa dang / rab gnas kyi gshom ni mchod pa rnams sta gon las mi nyung bar bshams pa nas/ tsa ru'i bza' ba phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i bar gong bzhin no/

/dngos gzhi'i cho ga la don bcu gsum gyis/ dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ tho rangs snga bar ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ gos ser po gyon stan la 'dug ste/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdus te he ru ka'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed mchod pa ni/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi bar snang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/

grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro dang ro langs la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhan yang gi lha rnams shar dkar zhes pa nas/ thags zangs ris dud kha rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de nas hūm̐ shrī he badz+ra na maḥ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon mo zhes pa nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / naṃ nai rāt+ma na maḥ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gaṃ gau rī na maḥ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa zhes dang / de bzhin du tsaṃ tsau rī na maḥ lhor tsau rīḥ baṃ bait+ta li na maḥ nub tu bait+ta līḥ ghaṃ ghasma rī na maḥ byang du ghasma rīḥ paṃ puk+ka sī na maḥ byang shar du puk+ka sīḥ shaṃ sha ba rī na maḥ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī na maḥ lho nub du gdol pa mo/ ḍaṃ ḍom+bi nī na maḥ nub byang du g.yung mo zhes sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma'i bar dang / rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye rdo rje'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes mtshan sngags lan gcig sbyar ba'i nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas bstim/

slar yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī ri sogs nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes sogs nas/ khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag pa yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang zhes sogs nas/ ghasma rī dang / ḍom+bi nī la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyi rlabs nas/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par mos pa byas la/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /sogs/ rol mo'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pa/ gos zung bsang sbyangs nas 'bul ba'i bar dang / mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung bar bsam zhing / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs kyi nang mchod phul nas/ rang gi myang ba'i bar dang / dril bu gsum brdung rol mo bya zhing / rang gi snying kha nas lha mo brgyad sprul ste mchod par bsam la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid mchod de rnams kyis bstod par bsam ste/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs dang / de nas rol mo bzhag tshigs bcad re'i rjes la dril bu bcad btubs su dkrol la/ gdangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /ces pa nas/ des ni 'jig rten der mtshungs shog /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod pa nyi shu pas bstod pa ste/ mdun bskyed bsgrubs te mchod rten bya ba'o/

/de nas lha bum gnyis ni bum pa sta gon gyi skabs su kha sang bsgrub zin pas mi dgos la/ khrus bum rnams dri bzang gi chus kha gsos la/ sta gon ltar bsgrub par bya'o/ /de na gnyis pa rten sbyang ba/ gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba/ bzhi pa ring srel gzhug pa/ lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa/ drug pa rten bskyed pa/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs ba sogs/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa/ dgu pa dbang bskur ba/ bcu pa mchod bstod/ bcu gcig pa spyan drangs byed pa/ bcu gnyis pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba gdab nas zhal bsgyur ba/ bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bgyi ba bzhi ste/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga thams cad gong du bshad pa'i dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar ma chad par bya'o/ /de nas mjug gi cho ga la yang don bcu gsum gyi dang po gtor ma sbyin pa/ gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba gnyis gong dngos gzhi rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar dang / gsum pa dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis rlabs te/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ hūm̐ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs rol mo dang bcas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang / bzhi pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ gtor mgron gyi rten med pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu'i ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/

/sogs dang / badz+ra muḥye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang nyid kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma'i bar dang / 'gro ba thams cad kye rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /ces brjod/ lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba/ drug pa yon bdag la shis brjod pa/ bdun pa rab gnas kyi rten la mchod pa/ brgyad pa bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba/ dgu pa slob dpon mchod pa/ bcu pa dga' ston bya ba/ bcu gcig pa slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod pa/ bcu gnyis pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba/ bcu gsum pa sbyin sreg bya ba ste cho ga thams cad gong dngos gzhi rgyas pa'i skabs ltar ma 'khrul bar bya'o/ /de ltar nub gnyis ma'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to// //deng sang nub gnyis ma'i phyag len 'di cung mi dar ba 'dug pas/ ma go ba'i gtam ma smra zhig don gsal la zhib tu gzigs na bkra shis pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur zhing / phyag len bde bas thams cad dges pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /rab gnas nub gnyis ma 'di/ nub gsum ma'i cho ga dang bsres nas gsungs shing gong ma'i gsung rab rdo rje'i tshig yin pas rang gi dad pa dang / bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi go ba ma gtogs kun gyis go bar ma nges so// //gnyis pa cho ga 'bring du bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid la sogs pa lnga ni gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /cho ga dngos la thog mar legs bshams ni/ yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku sogs gang 'byor gyi mdun du mchod gtor bshams pa/ rab gnas kyi rten gyi mdun du mchod pa rgya che zhing bkod pa mdzes pa/ mchod pa kha gso ba'i chas/ khrus stegs/ khrus gzhong sogs dang / rdzas gsum/ sku phyis/ sbyang ba'i chas/ mnga' dbul gyi stegs/ rten la dbang bskur ba'i dbang rdzas/ mnga' dbul gyi tsa ka li/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma/

tsa ru'i bza' ba/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum gdan steng rnam rgyal bum pa dang / las bum gnyis/ bum rdzas dkyil chog nas bshad pa ltar dang / khrus bum gcig tu bum rdzas brgyad ka ma tshang ba med par blug pa ste/ gsum ka la mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ gzhan dpon slob thams cad kyi mdun du rdo dril/ 'thor nas/ rol mo sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa bshams/ rten gsar pa rnams la dar sogs ser pos g.yogs te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi bsrung ba sogs bya'o/ /legs par bshams pa de dag 'bring po'i sta gon yin no/ /des na nang par tho rangs snga bar langs te/ gos ser po gyon nas stan la 'dug la gnas yo byin rlabs byas/ dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ lam dus rgyas pa byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus te he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i bar byas/ de nas bum pa bsgrub pa ni rnam rgyal dang / las bum dkyil chog ltar bsgrub nas khrus bum gcig po'i steng du rdo rje gzungs thag bzhag la gzungs thag mchu la bskor te slob dpon gyis bzung / bum pa bsang sbyangs nas/ rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gong gi nub gsum ma'i sta gon bzhin bya/ gnyis pa rten sbyang ba nas mnga' dbul rgyas pa'i bar gyi dngos gzhi don tshan bcu gsum tshang ma dang / mjug gi cho ga la/ dang po gtor ma sbyin pa/ gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba gnyis rnams gong rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar lhag chad med par bya/ gsum pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa rnams dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs nas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go

/ces brjod/ bzhi pa yon bdag bsgo ba/ lnga pa yon bdag la shis pa brjod pa/ drug pa rab gnas kyi rten la mchod pa/ bdun pa bsod nams bsngo ba/ brgyad pa slob dpon mchod pa/ dgu pa dga' ston bya ba/ bcu pa slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod pa/ bcu gcig pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba/ bcu gnyis pa sbyin sreg bya ba rnams rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin bya ba ste 'bring po'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to// //mjug chog gi sa bcad/ dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang / /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gcig po dor bas sa bcad gcig gi khyad ma gtogs/ gzhan dngos gzhi rgyas pa'i cho ga dang khyad par cher med do// //gsum pa cho ga bsdus pa'i phyag len 'di deng sang dar so med cing / phyag len cher mi mdzad 'dug pas ma bris so/ /yang byed par spro na don gsal dang / bkra shis rgya mtshor lta bar bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad bdun pa rab tu gnas par byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang / byas pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa dang / /byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na/ /de la bkra mi shis pa 'byung / /de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /rigs pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa na/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod mi byed/ /de de bzhin du gzugs can de/ /rab gnas ma byas gzugs can la/ /gang zhig mchod cing phyag byed pa/ /dam tshig bral zhing sngags dman pas/ /sbyin sreg thal ba 'bras med mtshungs/ /zhes bya ba dang / cho ga dang yo byad dman pa la nyes pa yod de/ cho ga dman pa mi bya ste/ /rab gnas rtag par bkra mi shis/ /'jig rten 'dir yang sdug bsngal zhing / /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub 'dod pas nan tan bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa legs par byas pa'i phan yon ni/ cho ga bdag nyid nus pa yi/ /rtog pa las gsungs tshul legs pas/

/de byas bsod nams che ba ni/ /mthong dang ma mthong 'bras bu skye/ /sku gzugs kyi ni mtshan nyid kyi/ /de la byin rlabs 'jug mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du yang sngags gnas pas/ /mchod ldan mchod par byed pa dang / /de yi las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /skye ba ru ni mchod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rab gnas legs par byas pas 'jig rten 'di dang / pha rol dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i bar du ji ltar smon lam btab pa ltar 'grub pa yin no/ /rab tu gnas pa'i phan yon bstan zin to/ /zhes pa don gsal las gsungs pa ltar bkod pa'o/ /ji ltar gsung ba bzhin/ rten la gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas gtso che ba yin kyang / deng sang dbus gtsang khams gsum na yon bdag dad pa dang / 'byor pa che zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi rten shi gson thams cad kyi ched du bzhengs pa zhig 'dug pa rjes su yi rangs te/ nged rang mchod gnas rnams gal chung chos kyi bya ba la mdzad pa'i stobs kyi gzungs gzhug dang / rag gnas kyi rnam gzhag sangs rgyas dang / bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab nas bshad pa dang mi mthun cing / chos kyi tha snyad mi shes pa rnams zog chos kyi mgo bo bskor ba dang / bzo rigs pa rnams kyis kyang rgya lugs yin zhes sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa'i phyag tshad g.yas su bzhag chu brag shing gsum bzo rtsed la gang spro byed pas rgyas bkab/ sangs rgyas kyi sku sogs la mi'i rnam 'gyur gya ma do byed/ phyag tshad dang ldan pa rnams la par bkab kyi ming 'dogs/ don bdud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i skyon gyis bstan pa dang / sems can la gnod cing / gong gi nyes pa de dag 'byung ba yin pas/ de bas rten bzhengs bzhag rten bzhengs pa'i rgyu dngos rnams dge 'dun gyi tshogs la bsnyen bskur 'bul 'gyed byas pa bsod nams dang khye che zhing nyes pa mi 'byung ba lags/ yang rten bzhengs kyi phan yon la dgongs bzhengs par spro na/

yon mchod thams cad thal mo sbyar te snying thag pa nas gsol ba ni/ bshes gnyen dam pa brtan zhing dul ba/ zol zog chung zhing gsung rab mtha' dag dang / phyag tshad la thugs rtog chug pa/ khyad par rab gnas dang / rten gyi bya ba la mkhas pa zhig gis/ sbyin bdag gi blo dang mthun par bzo rigs pa la sku'i rnam gzhag rnams phyag tshad ma 'chugs pa'i zhal bkod dang / bris sku yin na bar gzungs/ rgyab gzungs rnams ji ltar bshad pa bzhin so so'i bri rdzas dang bcas dag par bris/ yang ma bris kyang nyes pa cher med/ 'bur sku rnams rten gyi bya ba rdzogs nas gzungs gzhug byed dus/ gong bzhin sbyang ba gsum gyis bgegs bskrad/ de nas rten gyi nang la dri bzang sna tshogs bsres pa'i lde gu khye ma ma lus par byug yang sman sku yin na tshod lta yin byed cha skams na zhig pa'i skyon yong ngo / /gzungs gzhug 'bul mkhan yang dge slong / dge tshul/ dge bsnyen/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs sdom brtson dam tshig dang ldan pas byed/ de dag kyang khrus byas/ gos bzang po gyon/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don bzhin du las byed/ de dag la ja bur/ mar thud/ zho/ 'bras dkar gsum gyis thams cad tshim par byed cing / khar bu ram sogs cung zad tsam bcug la/ kha stong par mi byed pa sogs phyis longs spyod kyi rten 'brel du dgongs te phyag len la mdzad/ nang bzhugs la mchod rten gyi bre yan dang / sku'i gtsug gtor yod na gtsug gtor dang / dbu'i nang / thugs ka'i stod yan la bla gzungs rnams gzhug de yang 'bru gsum dang spel na/ oṃ āḥn mo badz+ra dha rā ya hūm̐/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ āḥn mo mañdzu gho ṣa ā nan+ta puṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha ṭā ya hūm̐/ zhes pa lta bu/ yang phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro dang spel na/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes dang / rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/

/zhes pa lta bu ste/ mdor na rang gang mos pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang lta bu thog mar gang yod nas rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi mtshan bris pa'o/ /'on kyang 'bru gsum dang spel ba'i skabs bla ma'i mtshan sangs rgyas 'o hūm̐ zer ba lta bu byung na/ de rang gi thad du phyag 'tshal dang spel ba legs so/ /de nas yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyi sngags dang / mdo sde nas 'byung ba'i sngags dang / gzungs sngags byin rlabs can mtha' dag bris pa mchod rten gyi bum pa dang / sku gzugs kyi thugs kha nas lte ba yan la rgyud sde'i go rim dang bstun nas gzhug yang sku chung ba dang ma 'byor na/ bla gzungs kye rdor man ngag lugs lta bu gcig dang / yi dam la aṣ+ṭa lta bu kye rdor lha dgu'i sngags tsam zhig gi chog go /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā zhes pa srog shing brten pa'i sngags yin te/ mchod rten yin na srog shing gi phyogs bzhi dang / sku gzugs kyi thugs kar gzhug oṃ sarba bi d+yā swāhā/ zhes pa rig pa chen mo'i sngags yin te mchod rten gyi bre dang / sku gzugs kyi dbur gzhug gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring srel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po ste gzungs chen lnga po 'di sku gzugs kyi pad gdan dang khri/ mchod rten gyi seng khri ma gtogs/ stod smad thams cad la khyab par bcug sku'i pad gdan nam khri/ mchod rten kyi seng khri'i dbus su gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ rang rang gi phyag len bzhin ma 'chugs par rtog pa zhib len gyis grub pa dang / zhag bdun bsgrub pa tshul bzhin byas pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo steng 'og phyogs ma nor bar shar rten gyi mdun phyogs la 'ong bar byas/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo dar ram ras ser pos gril/ gzhan gos dar gyi sna gang 'dzoms/ rin po che'i rigs/ 'bru sna/ zas sna bzang po rnams dar ram/

ras ser pos bstums la tshogs kyi bdag po dang / dzam+bha la sogs nor lha'i gzungs/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i mtha' bskor du bcug sku'i pad gdan nam khri/ mchod rten gyi seng khri'i g.yas g.yon du chos skyong bsrung ma'i sngags dang / phyogs skyong dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs dang / dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga'i gzungs rnams dar gyis gril nas dri bzang dang lhan cig gzhug pad gzungs gzhan ma 'byor na gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang / chos skyong / nor lha bkra shis kyi tshigs dang / yang sku chung zhing gnod sbyin 'khor lo ye ma 'byor na/ chos skyong nor lha/ bkra shis tsam bcug kyang rung / rig pa phug ron gyi gzungs gnyis gsum gang 'byor byas bcug na/ stod smad kyi gzungs 'khrugs pa des sel nus pas phan yon che zhes/ bdag gi bla ma yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub gsungs/ gzhan sangs rgyas kyi ring srel/ bla ma gong ma'i ring srel/ dbu skra phyag sen sogs bsags/ gdung tsha/ na bza' ji ltar rigs pa sku gzugs kyi sku dang / mchod rten gyi bre'i nang du gzhug bdud rtsi ril bu byung na sku'i mgrin pa dang / mchod rten gyi gang bder gzhug bla ma'i sku 'dra byung na thugs kha yan la dar zab dri bzang dang bcas te gzhug rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i sku yin na mu tig byu ru sogs rin po che'i phreng ba gang 'byor gyi rgyan dri bzang dang lhan cig tu yi dam gyi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i dar zab kyi gril/ de'i phyi nas shog bu sngon po'am/ gang 'byor gyi gzhi la gser dngul/ mtshal/ snag tsha gang rigs kyi yi ge dbu can bris la/ bcom ldan 'das che ge mo 'di zhes bgyi bas bdag sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo 'di zhes bgyi ba byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ longs spyod 'phel ba/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/

zhes bris pa mgo mjug ma log par gzungs nang la bstan nas dkris/ de gos dar mang pos bstums la bzhugs su gsol/ gzhan yi dam sangs rgyas sogs kyi sku byung na thugs kha nas lte ba yan gyi bar la gzhug mchod rten yin na bla ma'i sku bre dang / yi dam sogs bum par gzhug bla ma'i gdung tshwa shin tu mang na sku'i pad gdan yan dang / mchod rten gyi seng khri yan la bcug pas chog na bza' dang / gos dar mang na dri bzang dang lhan du gdung tshwa dang / gzungs kyi na bza' bya/ bla ma'i zhal bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs rten dang / gzhan zhabs lham gyi rigs gzhug tu mi rung bar byed do/ /bla ma dang gang zag mchog ma gtogs pa'i rus pa mchod rten gyi nang du gzhug par mi bya ste/ sems can la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'dul ba lung las 'byung ngo / /zhes kyang gzhug na yang / rus bu zhib par btags la 'jim pa dang bsres te/ gzungs kyi ring srel gyi snying po can du byas la/ tsha tshar btab ste bzhugs su gzhug go /gang zag mchog rnams la'ang de ltar byas na legs so snyam du sems so/ /zhes su don gsal las gsungs pa ltar bya/ gal te sku dang mchod rten che zhing ma khengs na/ sku'i lte ba man chad skyil krung yan dang / mchod rten gyi bum pa dang seng khri yan la rgyud sde dang / sde snod kyi po sti mdo phran sogs glegs shing med par byas la/ dri bzang gi phye ma dang lhan cig tu dar zab/ rten khebs sogs na bza' bzang pos gril/ dbu shog yar bstan/ zhabs shog mar bstan/ snga logs kyi gug skyed sku'i rgyab phyogs dang / zhabs kyu mdun phyogs la bstan te gzhug de yang / chos rnams gzungs kyi 'og tu 'ong bar byed/ mchod rten yin na mdun bum pa'i sgo phyogs shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi bar mtshams rnams sman sna/ 'bru sna/ dri bzang / rin po che sogs gang 'byor dar ram ras ser pos bstums la bcug mdor na stod smad tshang mar zing du kho nas tshags byas na brtan zhing khyad du 'phags pa myong bas grub pa lags/

ma 'byor na dri bzang gang rnyed dang / spang spos/ shug pa'i phye ma sogs dar ram ras ser po'i khug mar blugs la 'gengs/ gzungs rnams rgya shog sngon po la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po gang 'byor la pad gzungs ma gtogs bla ma'i gdung rus btul mas bri/ pad gzugs rnams gser dngul gang 'byor gyis bri/ de ma 'byor na thams cad snag tsha la sogs pas dpe cha ltar yig phreng gong 'og gi tshul du mi 'dri/ gzungs rnams gcig gi rjes la gcig ste phreng gcig tu bri/ de bzhin ma byas na lu btub kyi skyon 'byung ngo / /de ltar bris la dri bzang gi chus byug gzungs rnams mgo nas bsgril la/ mgo mjug dang stod smad kyi gzungs mi nor ba'i rtags dang / kha yig 'byar ba byas/ gdung tshwa sogs gzungs gzhug rnams dang lhan cig bzhag nang du mi 'jug gong du thams cad la rab gnas bsdus pa byas te gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas rten sogs kyi sdom ra shing dang / 'jim pa/ zangs gser la sogs pas legs par bsdams/ bris sku rnams la gong gsham zhal khebs sogs ma tshang ba med pa ste rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs nas/ zhag ma 'gyangs par rab tu gnas pa tshul bzhin legs par byas na bstan pa dang sems can la phan zhing / yon bdag rnams la gong du bshad pa'i phan yon de dag 'byung nges yin pas thams cad kyis de ltar thugs la bzhag nas mdzad pa gal che/ gzungs gzhug dang / rab gnas kyi mtha' spyod rgyas pa sogs/ rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i don gsal dang / rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i bkra shis rgya mtsho/ gser sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul sogs su rtogs par bya'o// //yang mgon khang lta bu mgon po lha brgyad kyi sku dang / zhal gyi sku yongs rdzogs sam/ gnyis pa gzugs gtso 'khor sogs kyi bris sku/ 'bur sku/ logs bris sogs gur zhal gtso bor gyur pa'i rab gnas thun mong ma yin pa bya tshul ni/

rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa sogs don tshan lnga ni gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /cho ga dngos la thog mar legs par bshams pa ni zur du bris sku dgram zhing mchod gtor bsham pa sogs mi dgos/ rab gnas la dgos pa'i khrus stegs/ mnga' dbul/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa gsum sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad gong rab gnas 'bring po ltar ma tshang ba med par bsham/ khyad par gyi chos ni gur zhal gyi rten gsar pa'i drung du/ stegs bang rim can la dam rdzas gtor ma bdun tshar dang / mnga' gsol gyi gtor ma nam mkha' rgyang bu dang bcas pa/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ de'i 'og star la bskang gso'i gtor ma so so'i phyag len bzhin shin tu rgyas pa/ de'i mdun du khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhu chen gyi snang gsal/ 'khris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas dang / steng du mi lpags dngos sam ras sogs la bcos pa'i g.yang gzhi'i bla bre/ bar snang la rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ glo snying gi 'phan tshar/ 'di rnams ched du gtad nas bsad pa ma yin pa'i dngos dang / sa gzhi la keng rus dngos bkram pa'am ri mor bris pa/ gzhan yang stag gzig go khrab/ gos dar/ ral gri sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin dang / de nas bang rim 'og ma rnams la spos/ me tog mar me/ zhal zas/ yon chab gang mang sogs gong bzhin bshams pa'o/ /dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ tho rangs snga bar langs te gos ser po gyon stan la 'dug la/ gnas yo byin rlabs byas/ lam dus rgyas pa byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i bar byas/ de nas bum pa bsgrub pa/ gnyis pa rten sbyang ba/ gsum pa 'khru zhing phyi ba/ bzhi pa ring srel gzhug pa/ lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa rnams gong rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin tshig rigs rnams brjod/ drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/

gur zhal sogs sku gang yod rnams a mṛ tas bsang / swa bha was sbyangs/ shū n+ya tās rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sogs nas lcam dral lha gsum hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥyis sgra sgrogs pa zhes pa'i bar dang / zhal yod na mgon po'i g.yas su pad+ma nyi ma ro'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin dang / mgon po'i thugs kha nas ya/ lha mo'i thugs kha nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las ya las nag po gnod sbyin sogs nas/ pho nya bsam gyi khyab pas bskor ba ces pa'i bar gtor chog ltar bskyed/ gzhan bla ma yi dam/ mchod rten po ti lta bu yod na gong rgyas pa'i sta gon ltar kye rdo rje rigs lnga sogs su bskyed/ gzhan yang des ring 'gre'o/ /bskyed tshar ba dang / lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod cing bsam la byin gyis rlabs/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba la/ spyan drangs pa dngos/ bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba'o/ /spyan drangs ba ni/ slob dpon gyis dril sil/ gzhan rnams kyi rnga cha langs/ mchod g.yog pa gnyis kyis rkang gling g.yab dar/ mgon po'i sbyar spos/ gu gul/ sha chen sogs dud pa shin tu che zhing rngam brjid dang ldan par byas la/ ngag tu/ rang gi snying kha dang / mdun bskyed chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kha sogs nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang /

yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ de nas rol mo rnams gcam zhing / rnga brdung dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang chen mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ /bram ze mchog sred bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /shrar+dha ka ra warma rin chen bzang / /yon tan tshul khrims la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /blo gros grags dang rje btsun sa skya pa/ /kun dga' snying po bsod nams rtse mo dang / /grags pa rgyal mtshan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /dam pa kun grags bdag nyid chen po dang / /bsod nams rgyal mtshan bla chen kun dga'i mtshan/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rgya gar shes bzang dang / /kun dga' bsod nams la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun 'dus shing / /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ngo bo nyid/ /chos skyong kun gyi phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /de 'dra gang yin bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /chos sku mkha' khyab pho brang lhun grub nas/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gang 'dul skur ston cing / /skal bzang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /mgon po lha mo kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus tshod 'dir/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ni ngan na yang / /shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'dir gshegs nas dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /na mo gu ru sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wi/ tsa turmu kha/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ kā la pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+ṣa si sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing sngags kyi rings la rol mo chems brdung dang / shug pa'i sgra cher bya zhing / mchod g.yog pa gnyis kyi g.yab dar g.yab cing rkang gling 'bud/ phyogs thams cad du bltas la brgyug dmigs pa ni gong du spyan drangs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sogs na bun 'thib pa ltar 'od zer dpag tu med pa dang bcas thib thib byon nas/ rten rnams kyi sku la char chen po babs pa ltar sib sib thim par bsam/ de nas rol mo rnams bzhag slob dpon gyis reng bu bzung / gzhan rnams kyi dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes pa nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes sngags dang bcas pa'i bar dang / bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba gnyis dang / brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa rnams sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / dgu pa dbang bskur ba/ bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa/ bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba/ bcu gnyis pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba gdab cing zhal bsgyur bya ba/ bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba bzhi rnams gong rgyas pa'i dngos gzhi ltar bya zhing / 'on kyang khyad par ni rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa'i skabs su gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ zhal bzhi pa/ las mgon sogs la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gzhan 'dra/ mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba'i skabs su drag po'i mchod pa rnams bskang rdzas byin rlabs ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ de nas 'phags pa rin po che'i mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod rgyas pa so so'i phyag rgya gdangs dang bcas pa/ dril bu dam tshig ma man la rnga brdungs ḍā dril/ rkang gling / dbyangs sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin rdzogs par mdzad/ rnga sil rnams bzhag mchod pa byin rlabs/ stong gsum 'di'am sogs thun mong ba rnams gong bzhin mdzad/ bstod pa'i skabs su bstod pa thun mong ba rnams song ba'i rjes/

dpon slob thams cad kyi rnga brdungs rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ mgon po la srin gzugs ma/ lha mo la gang sku ma/ zhal la dpal ldan dbang ldan ma/ las mgon lnga la/ mgon po'i bka' mnyan nag po gnod sbyin sogs tshig rgyas pa'am sh+lau ka re mdzad/ de nas rol mo bzhag la/ bye brag tu nye bar mkho ba'i mnga' dbul ba man mdzad/ mjug gi cho ga don tshan bcu gnyis po rab gnas 'bring po ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang gtor ma sbyin pa'i skabs su so so'i phyag len bzhin gtor bsngo/ bshags pa yan grub mtshams yi dam lha gtor ma gtogs/ dam rdzas gtor ma/ mnga' gsol gyi gtor ma/ bskang gso'i gtor ma rnams 'gab nas chu gtsang gis bran la/ de nas rim pa bzhin bsgrub khang gi steng du stegs gtsang ma la bzhugs su gsol la nang mchod kyi bran/ de'i mdun du ja gos dar/ dngul dam phor/ khrab rmog sogs gang 'byor gyis spyan gzigs bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo dril nang mchod sogs bzhag 'phyar dar sogs ci mang phyar/ spos sna gang 'dzoms dang / bsangs shing sna tshogs kyi bsangs dud sbyar/ dung rgya gling sogs rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa byed/ de nas dpon slob rnams steng du bzhugs gdan la 'khod/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs rnams so so'i phyag len bzhin byas la/ dpon slob rnams dbu zhwa phud bzhengs te/ rol mo thams cad 'bud dkrol bya zhing byin dbab la/ rnga brdungs dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi /sogs dam pas mdzad pa'i nag po mchod rten ma'i spyan 'dren dang / chos dbyings spros bral sogs sa los mdzad pa'i lha mo'i spyan 'dren rgyas pa dang / hūm̐ lha mchog ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /phrin las drag pos gdug pa tshar gcod cing / /zhes pa zhal gyi spyan 'dren rgyas pa dang / hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi /tshur gshegs mon pa ming sring gsum/

/sogs bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i pu tra'i spyan 'dren dang / che zhes chen mo gsang ba'i gzugs/ /sogs dkar bdud kyi spyan 'dren sngags dang bcas pa/ brtan bzhugs/ byon skyems gnyis sa lo'i bskang gso gsar pa ltar mdzad/ de nas bzhugs la/ bskang ba sogs so so'i gtor sngags lan gsum gyis phul/ phrin las bcol/ spyi bskang sku dang gsung thugs mal gyi mdzad pa la/ nged rang gi tshig gnyis kha skong su sbyar ba mdzad/ de nas mnga' gsol gyi shog ril rnams bklags te 'dur gdangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ kye yi rdo rje'i sprul pa ni/ /sogs dam pas mdzad pa'i mnga' gsol dang / hūm̐ dpal chen thugs kyi pho nya mchog /sogs bdag chen grags blo bas mdzad pa'i mnga' gsol rnams tshar gcig bklags tshar ba dang / dbu zhwa rnams bzhes sngags dbyangs dang / bstod pa sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma mdzad nas/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ bsngo ba smon lam grub mtshams/ tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad thams cad nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ byin rlabs nas bshags pa'i bar phur pa ltar rnga brdung dang bcas nas mdzad/ spyan 'dren/ bskang ba/ tshogs 'khor sogs rang rang gi phyag len bzhin byas pas khyab/ yang sbyin bdag 'byor pa zhan na tshogs 'khor mdzad pa/ 'og tu tsa ru'i bza' ba kho na la bsdus kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas dpon slob rnams bzhengs te pu tra bskul/ spyi bstab kyi gtor ma phul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor la sogs so so'i phyag len ltar mdzad nas 'og tu phebs te/ chos skyong bsgo ba man mdzad pa ste/ de dag gi ni mgon po'i rab gnas thun mong ma yin pa bstan zin to// //rab gnas grub dang bstun/ rjes gnang ma thob pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa la mi ston/ mgon po 'di shin tu rang gnyan pa'i grags pa dang bcas pas mnga' gsol bas/ de ltar du 'gyur ba legs te/ dper na lha 'dre grags pa can chags pa dang / gcan gzan gtum po dang /

mi thu mo la de ltar bsgrags pas thams cad tshar gcod cing / yid bzhin gyi nor bu la mnga' gsol byas pas dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de ltar mgon khang de la mchod gtor rgyun ma chad pa dang / khyad par tshil chen dang / sbyar spos sogs kyi dud pa rgyun ma chad par dbul zhing / de'i drung du bsgrub pa sogs byas na 'grub thag nye zhing / bar chad sel ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba myong bas grub pa lags/ 'di dag ni zhar byung gi yan lag ste thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bstan pa'o// //de rnams kyi rab gnas rgyas 'bring sogs don gsal gyi dgongs pa ci long byas/ gur zhal gyi rab gnas dpal kye rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i lugs kyi cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //deng sang gshin po'i don du rus pa bsreg sbyong byas tsha tsha btab nas/ kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gang ma mdzad pa'i phyag srol bzang po zhig 'dug na'ang / legs par brtags na cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag gang dang mi mthun pa zhig 'dug pa nas/ rang nyid kyi mi shes rung / gzhan la phan pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam rje btsun gong ma rnams dang / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la gsol ba btab nas bri bar bya'o/ /de la rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa sogs lnga ni gong du bstan pa bzhin dang / cho ga dngos la sdoms ni/ legs bsham bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /ring srel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ /rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya/ /de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang / /sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi 'o/ /zhes tshig rkang dang po 'don pa cung zad bsgyur te/ don bco lnga las/ dang po legs par bsham pa ni tsha tsha la sogs pa rten gsar pa stegs mtho bar bzhugs pa'i mdun du ras la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po la mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang /
