gzhan yang spos/ me tog mar me/ zhal zas/ yon chab sogs gang mang 'byor pa dang bstun bkod pa mdzes par bsham/ de'i mdun du khrus stegs dang / mnga' dbul gyi stegs sbyang chas/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa gsum bkod pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad/ nang mchod/ yi dam chos bsrung gi mchod gtor ma gtogs gzhan thams cad gong gi rab gnas 'bring po'i skabs ltar ma tshang ba med par bsham/ rten la dbang bskur ba'i dbu rgyan/ rdo dril gong bzhin la/ dar dpyangs dang rtsa chings dgos/ dpon slob rnams kyi bdag 'jug gi chas mi dgos/ rten gyi 'khris stegs zhig la chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma gong bzhin dang / de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ de bas stegs cung sma ba la cha gsum gtor ma rnams bsham pa'o/ /gnyis pa bdag bskyed pa ni/ thog mar mchod pa byin gyi rlabs pa la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ḥ ces phyag rgya dang bcas pas bgegs bsal/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phyag rgya dang bcas pas gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang zhing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ ces dang / dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod cing rol chen byas te mchod pa byin gyi brlabs bo/ /de nas bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa byas nas/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis chos bdag med par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' gsal ba'i lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lce'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nyal stabs su gnas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa zhes brjod pas lce rdo rjer byin gyi rlabs/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re/ de zhu ba lag pa thim pas lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang / sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang / g.yon khu tshur gyi dril bu snyems pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa cung zad khro ba sems dpa'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ baṃ dang / te rīn+ta'i phyag rgya nga rgyal bzung / phyag rgya de nyid spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ba g.yas pa/ ltag pa/ rna ba g.yon pa rnams su bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ gis gnas de lngar rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re bsam la sngags lan lnga brjod pas dbang blang / oṃ bruṃ dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mdud pa 'chings bzhin pa'i tshul du byas la/ snying kha mgrin pa ltag pa dang /

/snying kha nu ma'i bar dang ni/ /snying kha mgrin pa rgyab dpral ba/ /ces pa'i gnas rnams su reg la/ dar dkar po zhengs su khru gang pa/ dkyus su khru nyi shu rtsa gcig pas gnas dgur mdud pa bya zhing / dpral bar thal mo rtse sprad nas gsham brdabs te/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes pas rna ba gnyis kyi steng du dar dpyangs kyi 'gug phyung nas lhag ma lus dang mnyam par bsam ste bdag nyid rigs kyi khro bor bskyed pa'o/ /de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa'i phyir/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐ gis bgegs la bsnun/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bsregs/ oṃ badz+ra ne tri ban+dha sarba bigh+nan gyis bgegs bcings te sngar yod kyi bgegs bsal ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas oṃ dṛ dho me bhā wa ban+dha rak+ṣa sarbān swāhās 'og bcings/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa kyis steng bcings/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gi sngar gyi 'og bcings/ oṃ druṃ ban+dha haṃ gis shar bcings/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pā sha hrīḥ zhes pas shar gyi nang bcings/ oṃ pa taṅki pa taṅki ni raṭa kyis nub bcings/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kā li ruṭa maṭa kyis byang bcings/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ruṭa maṭa kyis lho bcings/ hūm̐ badz+ra karmas dal bcings/ hūm̐ ces pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi rwa ba bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ gyis thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni gzhan phan mtha' yas su blta bar bya'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs khro bo spyan 'dren/ bstod pa rnams gong gi spyan drangs ba'i skabs bzhin la/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgra༞ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /sogs mi brjod de/ gzhan phan 'od zer las khro bo'i bstod pa yang bya'o/ /zhes pa tsam las bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ma gsungs shing / bdag bskyed la 'brel yang med do/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya snying khar reg cing /

oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ dpral bar gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ lkog mar gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐/ spyi bor ā na ya ho bha ga wan bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la bdag bsrung / sngags dang phyag rgya de nyid kyi shar nas bzung nas phyogs bzhi dang / me nas bzung ste mtshams bzhir g.yas bskor du byas pas gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ste bgegs med par byas/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra karma kaṃ rdo rje bsrung ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+rarak+ṣa haṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ rnams kyis bdag brtan par bsrung / de dag gi phyag rgya ni gzhan phan mtha' yas su blta'o/ /dril bu bsil/ rdo rje gsor zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod cing brtan par bya'o/ /bdag bskyed dngos la gsum/ lha 'grub pa'i rgyu bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos/ ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de dag gi dbus su hūm̐ dang a/ thal mo gnyis la a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ tshar gnyis brjod pa rnams kyi gang ba las 'od zer 'phros pas g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la hūm̐/ gung mo la trāṃ/ srin lag la hrīḥ mthe'u chung la ā/ g.yas kyi mthe bong la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin chen 'byung ldan/ srin lag la 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bong la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung mo la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje rkun ma rnams pho mo'i khyad par ma gtogs zhal phyag rigs lnga dang 'dra bar gyur/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang /

oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmas lha dang lha mo rnams reg rdo rje thal mo dang / s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dharma badz+ra añdza lis rjes su zhugs/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang / a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma badz+ra ban+dhas gcig tu 'dres par bsam zhing sems 'od gsal bar bsam la/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya lan gsum dgrol zhing / badz+ra ban+dha traṭa kyis sdig pa thams cad bral/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha zhes dang / a bcu nas brgya'i bar bzlas nas snying khar dang po'i rdo rje char bzhin du dbab cing / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi dho me bhā wa/ sha shwa to me bhā wa hṛ da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes brjod cing phyag rgya dgrol/ yang phyag rgya de nyid bca' zhing badz+ra muṣ+ṭi brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ gis phyag rgya dgrol zhing se gol gtogs te/ ye shes pa rnams brtan par bsam mo/ /gzhan phan 'od zer gyi sgrub thabs ltar srung 'khor bsdus pa nyid shin tu 'brel che zhing skabs su babs pas mkhyen pa rnams kyis de ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos ni/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod cing stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu kha dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs par gyur/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sku dang / thal mo snyim par sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/

oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyi thugs byin gyi rlab bo/ /de nas dbang bskur te/ gsung dang / rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang / mtha' bzhi sbyar ba'i phyag rgya snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ tshin+da tshin+da sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyi thugs byin gyis rlab bo/ /de nas dbang bskur te/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ spyi bo dang / oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ dpral ba dang / oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ rna ltag g.yas dang / oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ltag pa dang / oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rna ltag g.yon du bzhag phyag rgya rnams gzhan phan mtha' yas bzhin no/ /mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod/ rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros/ spyir sems can thams cad dang / bye brag tu ngan song gsum/ khyad par tshe 'das sogs dmigs yul gang yin la phog pas/ de dag gi sdig pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsam la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang bsdu pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod de/ lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas nas/ mgo bos lan brgya stong phrag du mar phyag 'tshal te/

bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod/ /ces ched du brjod nas sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i 'gro ba de dag rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsam la/ byin gyi rlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dzā me gha sa ma dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod shap+ta dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar g.yas su bskor zhing / sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod pas bstod par bsam mo/ /de nas gsum pa ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du oṃ na mo bha ga wa te nas/ bi shud+dha swāhā'i bar gyis rtsa rig lan gcig brjod la/ de las 'od 'phros ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ slar 'dus rang gi snying kha'i chos kyi yi ge la thim zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud+dhu+e bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa rat+na bi shud+dhe swāhā/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas bsgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsam/ slar bdag nyid la mchod bstod bya ba'i phyir/ gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/

/sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad sngags rnams go rjes la/ me tog dang puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang dhū pe/ snang gsal dang ā lo ke/ dri mchog dang gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang nai wi d+ye/ rol mo dang shap+ta rnams kyis mchod la/ rol chen dang / dharma ra ṇi brjod/ rdo dril 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas te/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sku ste sku che ba/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog /rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba/ /rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa/ /rdo rje rnon po rno ba che/ /mchod pa chen po rgya mtsho che/ /rdo rje pad+ma byang chub che/ /byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba/ /rdo rje rgya chen rgya chen ste/ /rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje pad+mo rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che/ /rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa bsrung ba che/ /rdo rje lcags kyu don yod byed/ /rdo rje ro langs ro langs byed/ /rdo rje srin po za ba po/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje gdon de gdon gyi mchog /'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa/ /bsgrub dka'i bsgrub pa legs pa ste/ /rdo rje legs pa dgyes mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa/ /'od stug pas ni stug pa che/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/

/rdo rje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho/ /rdo rje ye shes ye shes che/ /rig sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyi bskor/ /ha la ha la nag po che/ /dgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa can/ /rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che/ /snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba/ /skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod/ /glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro/ /rdo rje me ste ma rungs 'dul/ /drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa/ /nyi ma stong gis gdungs pa'i zhal/ /spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po/ /khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro/ /phyag rnams du mar mtshon cha brgya/ /du ma'i zhal te sku yang stong / /'khyil zhing brgyan yang 'khyil pa ste/ /sems kyi chos pas sku mi mnga'/ /rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul/ /ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar byed/ /sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can/ /rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba/ /zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku/ /kun tu bzang po cher bzang po/ /mtshan rnams dam pas rnam brgyan pa/ /khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po/ /thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang / /zhes pas bstod de bdag bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa bum pa bzlas pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba dang / rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag gzungs thag rnam rgyal dang las bum gyi mchu la bskor/ de nas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang /

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs khar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu kha dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ las thams cad pa'i bum par k+ṣa las rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po rab tu khros pa/ phyag gnyis kyi zhal g.yas g.yon gyi thad khar mche ba 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i nyams can/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ dril bu sil zhing gdangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ ma lus sems can kun gyi zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du bsres/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas bdag bskyed ltar dbang bskur/ de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ de bzhin du sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ ar+ghaṃ gyi tshab tu puṣ+pe nas shap+ta'i bar gyis rol mo phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/

/rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi bzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la/ /zhes pas bstod/ pad skor byas nas gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes pa dang / las bum la oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ dang / khrus/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa sngags dang po gnyis brgya rtsa la sogs pa gang mang dang / nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod de gzungs thag bsdus la/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar pad skor byas te bum pa gnyis su dung chos kyi chu blugs la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa khrus bum gyi steng du bzhag gzungs thag mchu la bskor/ las bum gyi chu ku shas khrus bum la gtor te/ bsang sbyangs nas rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang / bzhi pa rten sbyang ba/ lnga pa khrus bya ba sogs gong gi nub gsum ma'i sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /drug pa ring srel gzhug pa/ bdun pa gsol ba gdab pa gnyis dngos gzhi rgyas pa'i skabs ltar bya/ brgyad pa rten bskyed pa ni yak+ṣas bsang / swa bhā wa sogs kyis rten rnams mi dmigs ste stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tsha tsha la sogs pa gtso bo yin na seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/

zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang gi dbus su seṅge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyi bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ dbus su oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag lhor traṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag byang du ā las don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ zhes dang / bla ma'i sku lta bu yin na stong pa'i ngang las seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po oṃ āḥhūm̐? gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ gzhan rten ngo mi shes pa dang / ngo shes kyang ha cang grangs mang ba rnams phyogs gcig tu seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan re re'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa re re yongs su gyur pa las/

gong bzhin rdo rje 'chang ngam/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs par bskyed pa gang bde'o/ /chos po ti yin na hrī las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gis phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ lha khang dang / gtsug lag khang sogs dang / khang bzang rta babs sogs rgyas pa'i skabs su bstan pa thams cad la sku'i bskyed chog thun mong ba'i bskyed lugs gong ltar bya zhing rgyud sde gong 'og gi rnam dbye shes par bya'o/ /dgu pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba/ bcu pa rgyas gdab pa rnams sa'i lha sta gon bzhin la/ dgug gzhug gnyis kyi dus gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs mi zer ba/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ā/ zhes kun rig nas 'byung ba ltar phyag rgya dang bcas pa tsam khyad par ro/ /rgyas gdab 'bru gsum gyi byed pa ni/ don gsal las bya spyod yo ga thams cad la 'bru gsum gyis byas pas chog par gsungs shing / rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kun rig gi sbyin sreg ro sreg tsha tsha gdab pa'i rim pa'i tsha tsha'i rab gnas skabs nas kyang gsungs so/ /bcu gcig pa dbang bskur ba ni/ don gsal las/ bya spyod kyi lugs dang mthun par byed na/ chu dang cod paṇa dang / phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur la/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ 'dir ni rnal 'byor rgyud gtso bor byas pa yin pas rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur la/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs yin na dbang bzhi ka bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas 'dir rig pa'i dbang lnga dang /

rdo rje slob dpon gyi bskur ba tsam brjod par bya'o/ /de la thog mar skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig po lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa bteg nas rten rnams la nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang / slob dpon gyis rten gyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma ka la sha a ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur tshul byas la/ bum chu ting la sogs pa'i snod du blug de nyid mchod g.yog pas rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag de ni mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi dod do/ /de nas dbu rgyan slob dpon gyis rten la 'bul tshul byas la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur tshul byas la/ mchod g.yog pa la gtad rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag yang rin po che'i rtsa chings 'bul tshul dang / oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ zhes brjod/ dar dpyangs kha dog sna lnga 'bul tshul dang / oṃ badz+ra pa ṭa laṃ pa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ zhes brjod cing rtsa chings dang / dar dpyangs gnyis ka phyogs gcig tu mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ rten gsar pa'i drung du dbu rgyan dang lhan cig tu bzhag pa rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang gi dod do/ /de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang / phyag mtshan lngas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu phul bar bsam zhing / dngos su rdo rje dang dril bu 'bul tshul byas la/

oṃ bud+dha mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod cing dkrol la mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag pa rdo rje dang dril bu'i dbang stabs gcig tu bskur ba 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa'i dbang gi dod do/ /de nas slob dpon rang gi mdun gyi rdo dril lhan cig tu dkrol zhing / rten la rigs lnga'i gsang mtshan 'dogs par bsam la/ oṃ bud+dha nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod cing rdo dril bzhag pa rnam par de ming gi dbang gi dod do/ /de dag brtan pa'i phyir du sna tshogs rdo rje rten la phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes brjod de rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /'di la dbang rdzas dngos su mi mdzad/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ste rigs lnga'i dbang ngo / /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya rten la btugs pa'i rkyen gyis seṅge'i khri sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rten rnam snang chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpar gyur par bsam la phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ ces brjod/ de la dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ slob dpon mdun gyi rdo dril lhan cig dkrol te/ rten gyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar dgrol bar bsam zhing / oṃ bud+dha tsakra a di pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ

oṃ karma tsakra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes brjod cing rdo dril bzhag la/ slob dpon nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rten dang bcas pas phyag rgya mdzad par bsam ste rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bcas la/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra sogs gong bzhin brjod pas rten dang rigs lnga spro ba po rnam snang rdor sems su gyur par bsam pa ste phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi dod do/ de nas rdo rje/ chos 'byung / pad+ma/ spyan/ ut+pal te yum lnga'i phyag mtshan/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lnga dang mthar phyag g.yon du phul bar bsam zhing / dngos su dril bu rkyang pa dkrol la/ oṃ bud+dha dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī/ oṃ karma dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod cing 'bul tshul byas te/ dran pa shes rab dang ldan par bsam pa gsung gi dam tshig gi dod do/ /de nas rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rten gyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar btugs te mthar phyag g.yas su phul bar bsam la/ rdo rje gsor zhing dngos su 'bul tshul byas nas/ oṃ bud+dha gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī/ oṃ karma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bzhag ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa bskyed par bsam pa ste rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi dod do/ /rdo dril phyag tu byin par bsam la/ oṃ pradzñā u pa yo ga sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ aḥ zhes brjod de/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs bdag gi dbu brgyan pa nub gsum ma'i sta gon bzhin no/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni mi dgos te/ rigs lnga'i dbang gi nang du mi gtogs pa'i phyir ro/

/yang nges par bskur dgos na/ mtha' brten rgyal srid sna bdun dang / bka'i dbang bskur sogs thams cad dgos par 'gyur bas ha cang thal ches so/ /bcu gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ mchod pa'i mar me rnams sbar/ zhal zas dang / mar me gsar pa yod na'ang phul zhing / mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ gong bzhin byin gyi rlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /sogs tshigs bcad gdangs phyag rgya dang bcas pas rol mo'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas/ dril sil gdangs dang bcas pas/ snang stong rdo rje sogs kyis bstod do/ /bcu gsum pa spyan dbye ba rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin dang / bcu bzhi pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhing zhal bsgyur ba ni phal cher rgyas pa bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ mchod pa'i skabs su mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / bstod pa'i skabs su snang stong rdo rje sogs brjod pa tsam mo/ /bco lnga pa mnga' dbul rgyas pa bya ba bzhi yang cho ga rgyas pa'i dngos gzhi'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba'i skabs su mchod pa kha gsos la/ mchod pa byin rlabs bdag bskyed kyi gong bzhin byas la/ gdangs phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / de bzhin du tshigs bcad/ sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ me tog ji snyed puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang dhū pe/ snang gsal dang ā lo ke/ dri chab dang gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang nai wi d+ye/ rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang /

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe ra ṇi sogs kyis rol mo dbul/ tsha tsha rkyang pa yin na sgos bstod gzhan rnams bzhag la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /sogs mchod rten gyi bstod pa man rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas rang rang gi blo la gang yod bya/ sbyin sreg mi mdzad/ yang byed par spro na gzhan phan 'od zer ltar rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /tsa ru'i bza' ba rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar rang rang gi phyag len ltar bya/ sngags kyi mnga' dbul zhing bkra shis kyi rjes kyi mchod pa la mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa ste chu gnyis sngon du mi mdzad pa tsam khyad par ro/ /sa bcad ni legs bsham dang / bum bskyed gnyis bsnan pas bco lngar song ba ma gtogs cho ga la khyad par med do/ /mjug gi cho ga la sdoms ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo/ /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/ /yon bdag bsgo zhing shes pa brjod/ /rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo/ /slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya/ /slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod/ /rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no/ /zhes pa ltar don bcu gnyis las/ dang po gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ cha gsum gtor ma rdo rje 'chang gi mdzad pa'i deng sang yongs grags kyi cho ga ltar btang ba'o/ /gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ chang gis sbyangs la gtor chog ltar byin gyi rlabs/ gzhan gong rgyas pa'i skabs ltar ro/ /gsum pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas gong bdag bskyed bzhin rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs sngags rgyas sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bdag dang / gnas dang / rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/

/bzod par gsol ba ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ de nas ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /sogs sh+lau ka gcig po byas kyang btub/ yang spro na/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyi mjug tu/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing / dbang ma thob pas sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa la sogs pas cho ga nyams chag 'gal 'khrul yo byad ma tshang ba sogs nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad/ bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ gshegs su gsol ba ni/ cha gsum gyi gtor mgron gyi so sor gshegs zin pas 'dir mi dgos so/ /bzhi pa yon bdag bsgo ba/ lnga pa yon bdag la shes pa brjod pa/ drug pa rab gnas kyi rten la mchod pa/ bdun pa bsod nams bsngo ba/ brgyad pa slob dpon mchod pa/ dgu pa dga' ston bya ba/ bcu pa slar yang shis pa rgyas pa brjod pa/ bcu gcig pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba/ bcu gnyis pa sbyin sreg bya ba rnams rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin no/ /'on kyang rten la mchod pa'i skabs mchod yon sngon 'gro ma gtogs chu gnyis mi mdzad/ sbyin sreg gi dod yig brgya la rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa tsam mo/ /de dag gis ni kun rig gi phyogs tsam la brten pa'i rab gnas 'bring po'i cho ga bla ma gong ma'i phyag len lhag chad dang bsre lhad med pa yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to// //yang kun rig gi bdag 'jug sogs yongs su rdzogs la brten nas sta gon gyi cho ga sogs nyin gsum ma mdzad dgos na/ deng sang kun rig la brten nas mdzad pa po la kun rig gzhan phan mtha' yas bzhin bdag 'jug rnams yongs su rdzogs pa grub zin nas/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la 'jug pa zhig 'dug ste/ 'di rgyas pa'i lugs yin na nub dang po sta gon gyi cho ga med/

'bring po'i lugs yin na mdun bskyed bdag 'jug dang bcas pa ma gsungs pa'i phyir cho ga gang dang mi mthun no/ /yang gang zag la la bdag bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa byas nas bum bskyed la kun rig gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bskyed pa dang / khyad par las bum dang khrus bum med par lha bum de nyid la khrus bum brgyad kyi sngags bzla ba gcig 'dug pa 'di ni mun sprul chen po yin te/ rje btsun rin po che'i dgongs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de gang zhe na/ don gsal las/ bdag bskyed pa ni rdo rje 'byung ba'am/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa'am/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa'ang rung ste/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bya/ de la ci 'byor pa'i mchod pas mchod nas bzlas pa cung zad gcig bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa yin na bsdus te bdag dpa' bo gcig pa'i nga rgyal du bskyed pa ni bdag dpa' bo gcig pa'i nga rgyal du bskyed pa ni bdag bskyed ces bya ba yin no/ /de nas gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni sngar mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor med pa'i dbang du byas na/ bum pa sta gon 'dir bya dgos te/ lha'i bum pa du yod pa'i nang du bdag gi rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'am/ dpa' bo gcig pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed cing rang rang gi bzlas pa oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ zhes pa la sogs pa bzla/ de nas las thams cad pa'i bum par rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po rab tu khros pa phyag gnyis kyi mche ba 'dzin par bskyed la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pa brgyad rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas/ dri ma khrus kyi bum pa brgyad du lha bskyed ni mi dgos/ rang rang gi sngags bzlas so/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas shes ldan gzur gnas rnams kyi dgongs/ des na deng sang rab gnas kyi chog dpon mdzad mkhan kun gyis ras kha do la ma brtsegs par khrus stegs dang /

mnga' dbul re bris/ las bum dang khrus bum ste bum pa gsum re cis kyang 'byor pa mdzad do/ /las sla dang / dbang che gshe mongs chos la mi 'gro/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i las rgyu 'bras dran par byas la/ bstan pa dang sems can mi bsam na'ang / rang ngan song du mi ltung ba'i thabs re mdzad do/ /rten gyi gzungs gzhug dang / tsha tsha dang / sku phran tshegs/ lam lta bur glo bur du rab gnas byed dgos byung na/ bsdus pa 'di bzhin bya ste/ 'jam dbyangs/ tshe dpag med/ 'chi 'joms sogs lha gang yang rung ba'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa nyams su len pa'am/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thun mtshams kyi lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin pas rten la yungs dkar la sogs pas brab/ 'byor na gu gul gyis bdugs/ sum+bha ni sogs drag sngags brjod/ rang gi snying kha nas khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs bskrad par bsam/ bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang bas rten gyi dri ma bkrus par mos pa byas la/ ji ltar bltams pa/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags bcas brjod/ sku phyis par bsam la/ de dag sku la sogs brjod/ de dag ni mos pa tsam byas pas chog de nas shū n+ya tās rten rnams stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan re re'i steng du bla ma yi dam/ chos skyong / nor lha/ rten ngo mi shes pa dang / ngo shes kyang ha cang mang drags pa rnams phyogs gcig tu oṃ ā hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa re re yongs su gyur pa las thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa zhes brjod/

dkyil 'khor yin na hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gyur pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha gtso 'khor thams cad gong bzhin rdo rje 'chang du bskyed/ mchod rten dang / tsha tsha rnams seṅges bteg pa'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang gi dbus su seṅge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la dbus su oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag lhor trāṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag byang du a las don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i mthar bskor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ zhes dang / gzungs dang / gsung rab rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥyis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/

dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing / zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ man thang lta bu yin na'ang gong gsung rab bzhin bskyed/ 'on kyang sku yod na sku gzhan dang 'dra bar bskyed dgos/ gzhan bskyed chog dgos pa byung na gong rnams su bshad pa ltar rigs 'gros rnam dpyod kyi spyad nas bsdus pa re mdzad/ de nas lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐ḥ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems cad sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi mthar/ sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mang du brjod de so so la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkha' gang ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na/ /lha mo sgyur 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs can lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin rlabs shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang yang brjod de lha so so la thim par bsam/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa māḥdzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing gsung bar bsam/ de ltar na bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhās mchod/ bsod nams ye shes rab rdzogs shing / /stong pa dang ni snying rje'i bdag /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i dpal/ /rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /sku bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas lha rnams kyis spyan 'byed pa'i tshul byas la/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ne swāhā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob ste/ sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa lan gsum brjod/ ye dharmas byin gyi rlabs pa'i me tog gtor te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

khyad par du yang rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ye swāhā/ zhes dang / ye dharma mang du brjod la me tog gtor/ rdo rje 'chang rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam sogs gong du gang bskyed dgos byung ba'i sku'i rnam pa ji ltar ba bzhin du gyur/ 'od dpag med rnams 'od du zhu ba las gzungs dang / gsung rab/ man thang la sogs pa ā li kā li'i rang bzhin gyi glegs bam/ gzungs/ man thang la sogs pa rnam pa ji ltar ba bzhin du gyur/ gzhan zhal bsgyur dgos pa yod na rigs 'gre sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /de nas gong bzhin mchod bstod byas/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyis bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ nyin mo bde legs sogs kyi mjug tu rten 'brel snying po dang / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+ruṃ khaṃ badz+rī bhā wa dṛ d+dha tiṣ+ṭha bhū khaṃ swāhā/ ces pa yang yang brjod de rten thams cad la me tog khyab par gtor ro/ /de dag gis ni rab gnas nyer mkho bsdus pa bstan zin to/ /rten gyi gzungs rdzong la med thabs med pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bsgrub tshul kho bos logs su bris pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /rab 'byams gzhung lugs ji snyed ma gtogs kyang / /rab dkar lhag bsam dag pas bstan 'gro'i don/ /rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba bshad pa'i mthus/ /rab gtum bdud kyi bar chad zhi bar shog /don gsal mchog gi dgongs don ma lus par/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes bdag gi rtogs sam snyam/ /sa lo'i phyag len gsung rgyun gyis brgyan nas/ /dad pas sbyar bas bstan pa dar bar shog

/'di bris rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba des/ /shes brgyud sgrib sbyangs sangs rgyas sa thob nas/ /mar gyur 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar shog /de ltar rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag rgyas shing shin tu zhib par bstan pa 'di ni mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la mkhas shing / bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba la khur gyis mi ngal ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa mkhan chen skyog po dpal ldan bzang po ba dang / mkhan chen dbu dkar ba kun dga' bkra shis sku mched kyi yang yang bkas bskul ba dang / dad ldan gyi slob ma ka bcu pa blo gros seṅge sogs kyis kyang dran bskul byas shing / rang nyid kyang chung ngu nyid nas rab gnas kyi cho ga 'di/ rje btsun gyi gsung bzhin dag par byas na/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don 'di bas lhag pa mi 'dug snyam pa'i dad pa dang spro ba gzhan las lhag pa zhig yod cing / cho ga thang re tshar ba'i rjes la 'jig rten gyi khams su dge legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung nges snyam pa'i dga' spro yid bde ba dang / rjes su yi rang sogs bcos min re nges par skye ba cig yod pa nas/ bstan bcos 'di lta bu cig bya dgos snyam yang / le lo'i dbang gis 'gyangs pa la/ gong gi bskul ba po rnams kyi rkyen byas/ rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po spun dang / rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa dang / bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur na ci ma rung snyam mi shes bzhin du spyi brtol bskyed de/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/

chos med snyoms las mkhan dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta'i lo nag pa zla ba'i dus khyad par can tshes bco lnga'i nyin dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so/ /nyes pa rnams sa lo chen po la bzod par gsol zhing / 'dis bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas par gyur cig nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du sa lam gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs so// //yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod ldan pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor ga chen gyis gus pa'i sgo nas bgyis so// //maṅga laṃ sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 100 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 99
